title: Technical Marketing Engineer
description:
****Job Description****
 In this exciting role you will be part of a global family of market leading innovators who share the same passion for engineering and materials technology, where a mix of internal knowledge and new external eyes comes together to deliver on business needs. This is truly a chance to take ownership of an area and build something. It’s also a chance to join an organization eager to adapt new solutions and continuously improve. You can visit our website for more details: www.alleima.com
   

  

**Position: Technical Marketing Engineer/Specialist**
****Your Role:****
 The Technical Marketing Engineer role is focused on maintaining and developing technical knowledge of Alleima tubular products and their applications. Technical marketing involves producing technical content in the form of webinars, journal articles, white papers, and conference presentations to promote Alleima products to our customers. This position is a link between R\&D, Marketing, Sales, and corrosion/process experts in our customer's organizations. This role reports to Technical Marketing Manager withing Sales Unit India. Your base location shall be
 **Pune (flexible)** 
 .
   

  

****Your Main Task And Responsibilities Include:****
 Technical discussions with customer’s corrosion engineers to understand their corrosion problems, analyse corrosion risks based on service conditions and recommend suitable materials. Actively search and develop new applications, establish knowledge, and value arguments
   

  

 To actively promote the current range of grades \& products, together with the introduction of new products to market. You shall become an active representative and presenter for important conferences related to our tubes to promote Alleima, write technical articles for conferences and journals
   

  

 Maintain and develop the relationship with technical teams at key customers with the support from Sales
   

  

****About You****
 We are looking for someone holds a bachelor’s degree in Metallurgical or Materials Engineering. You should have practical knowledge of wet corrosion and high temperature corrosion, including corrosion mechanisms, corrosion tests and failure modes in different industry applications.
   

  

 You have minimum 3\+ years experience of working with corrosion. Knowledge and experience of specific segments like Refinery, Fertilizers, Chemicals and Steel is an advantage. Understanding of standards like ASTM, API, ASME etc is an added advantage
   

  

 You have excellent communication skills to effectively present technical information to customers, their top management, audience at technical conferences, and to Alleima international colleagues. Available for frequent travels, able to work well under pressure and challenges.
   

  

 As a person you are self\-motivated and one with lot of initiative, courage and integrity and a business minded, positive and result oriented attitude. A team player, who has good communication skills and stakeholder management skills. You have excellent English language skills and enjoy working with multicultural partners.
   

  

****What You Can Expect From Us****
 At Alleima we are convinced that diversity leads to a better environment for our employees, our company, and our customers. We offer you great development opportunities in a global industrial group with favorable employment conditions that includes:
   

  

 A great workplace that always trying to create conditions for developing good physical and mental health for our employees.
   

  

 A positive environment that all our people can operate at their full potential and at the same time feel valued and welcomed whoever they are.
   

  

 A fair and equitable compensation package encompasses not only compensation but also pension, benefits, career development, work environment etc., based upon the position, local market, experience, and performance.
   

  

****Additional Information****
 Travel frequency: \>25%
   

  

 At Alleima, our mission is much more than delivering high\-quality products, technology, and processes \- working together to develop solutions based on our customers' needs and thus achieve our business goals, is a better way to describe our daily work. With curious employees and safety as our priority, we create a work environment where you can develop both personally and professionally.
   

  

 Alleima was listed as a stand\-alone company on the Nasdaq Stockholm Exchange on August 31, 2022\. With a clear direction for our journey ahead, utilizing our position as a technology leader, progressive customer partner, and sustainability driver, we aim to become an even stronger company in our industry.
   

  

 Are you ready to take on this challenge together with us? Join us on our journey! www.alleima.com
   

  

****What You Can Expect From Us****
 Alleima offers a competitive total compensation package including comprehensive benefits. In addition, we provide opportunities for professional competence development and training, as well as opportunities for career advancement. You shall enjoy the diverse and inclusive culture we are nurturing at Alleima!
   

  

****Additional Information****
**How to Apply:**
 Alleima employee may upload updated profile in Workday through own login and apply or refer a candidate against the
 **JR No. R0038401, no later than September 30, 2026\.**
**Or**
 Please send your application by registering on our site Open jobs — Alleima and uploading your CV against the
 **JR No. R0038401, no later than September 30, 2026\.**
**For Further Information About This Position, Please Contact:**
 Ganesh Prasad, Hiring Manager, ganesh.prasad@alleima.com
   

  

**For Further Information About The Recruitment Process, Please Contact:**
 Amita Patil, Recruiter, amita.patil@alleima.com

title: Content Writing & Marketing Intern
description:
**About FundNexus** 




  





 FundNexus is an early\-stage startup building a platform for the startup and investor ecosystem. We are currently preparing for launch and looking for a motivated Content Writing \& Marketing Intern to join our early team.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




  





 This role is ideal for someone who enjoys writing, researching, understanding startups, and creating meaningful content. You will work closely with the founding team and contribute to FundNexus's website, social media, marketing, and research initiatives.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 Content \& Website
 



  





 \- Write and update website content, landing pages, product pages, FAQs, and founder/investor profiles
 



 \- Research and write blog and SEO\-focused content
 



 \- Help maintain and improve website content
 



  





 Social Media
 



  





 \- Draft LinkedIn posts and captions
 



 \- Create carousel copy and short\-form video scripts
 



 \- Develop content hooks and thought\-leadership drafts
 



 \- Support founder and company LinkedIn content
 



  





 Marketing
 



  





 \- Draft emails, newsletters, campaign and partnership communication
 



 \- Assist with PR drafts and case studies
 



 \- Develop startup and founder stories
 



  





 Research
 



  





 \- Conduct competitor and industry research
 



 \- Research startups, investors, and the broader startup ecosystem
 



 \- Identify relevant topics, trends, and content opportunities
 



 \- Support research for FundNexus content and marketing initiatives
 



  





 Who We're Looking For
 



  





 \- Strong interest in content writing, marketing, startups, or the business ecosystem
 



 \- Good written English and attention to detail
 



 \- Strong research and information\-gathering skills
 



 \- Ability to simplify complex information into clear content
 



 \- Willingness to learn and take ownership of assigned work
 



 \- Students, recent graduates, or aspiring content/marketing professionals are welcome
 



  





**What You'll Get** 




  





 \- Hands\-on experience working with an early\-stage startup
 



 \- Exposure to startup, investor, and business ecosystems
 



 \- Opportunity to work directly with the founding team
 



 \- Practical experience in content, research, SEO, and marketing
 



 \- Opportunity to build a strong portfolio through real FundNexus projects
 



 \- Potential to grow into a larger role based on performance and commitment
 



  





**Compensation** 




  





 This is currently an unpaid internship opportunity.
 



  





 As an early\-stage startup, FundNexus is currently operating with limited resources. We are prioritizing learning, ownership, and meaningful hands\-on experience at this stage. As FundNexus gains significant traction and reaches defined milestones, interns demonstrating strong contribution may be prioritized for a paid stipend opportunity.
 



  





**Internship Details** 




  





 Role: Content Writing \& Marketing Intern
 



 Work Mode: Remote / Hybrid
 



 Type: Internship \| Unpaid
 



 Commitment: Part\-time / Flexible
 



 Experience: Freshers and students are welcome
 



  





 If you are passionate about writing, research, startups, and building something from an early stage, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Marketing Associate _ Baxture Technologies _Pune/Srinagar WFO
description:
**Role: Associate: Marketing** 




**Location: Pune** 




**Work Mode: Work from Office** 




**Experience: 2–3 Years** 




**Working Days: Monday to Friday** 




**Industry: IT Services \& Consulting** 




**About Baxture** 




**Baxture is an IT consulting and technology services company helping businesses build, modernize, and scale digital products and software solutions. Our capabilities span Custom Software Development, Product Engineering, UI/UX, QA, DevOps, Cloud, AI\-powered solutions, and Software Support \& Maintenance.** 




**We work across multiple industries and combine technology, engineering expertise, and business understanding to solve real\-world challenges.** 




**About the Role** 




**We are looking for a self\-driven Marketing Associate who can combine digital marketing, content creation, SEO, and sales enablement to strengthen Baxture’s digital presence.** 




**This role is ideal for someone who understands the IT services industry, enjoys creating content around technology and business, and can independently take ownership of marketing initiatives from planning and creation to execution and performance analysis.** 




**What You’ll Do** 




**SEO \& Website Growth** 



* Conduct keyword research and identify opportunities to improve Google search visibility.
* Create and optimize website pages, landing pages, blogs, and SEO\-focused content.
* Use Google Analytics and search performance insights to understand traffic and improve website visibility.
* Identify content gaps and opportunities for organic growth.



**Content \& Social Media** 



* Research and write blogs, thought leadership content, website copy, and technology\-focused content.
* Create engaging content for LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and X.
* Repurpose blogs and long\-form content into social posts, carousels, newsletters, and other formats.
* Build and own the marketing and social media content calendar.



**Sales Enablement \& Campaigns** 



* Create white papers, newsletters, brochures, flyers, sales decks, pitches, one\-pagers, conference announcements, and reusable marketing templates.
* Plan and execute email marketing campaigns using Brevo.
* Work with sales teams to create content that supports business development.



**Stakeholder Collaboration** 



* Work directly with founders, leadership, sales, project managers, designers, and technical teams.
* Understand business objectives and translate them into actionable marketing plans.
* Work with internal subject matter experts to turn technical knowledge and project insights into compelling content.



**AI \& Creative Tools** 



* Use tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Gamma, and Genspark for research, ideation, content creation, and presentations.
* Evaluate, fact\-check, and refine AI\-generated content rather than relying on raw outputs.
* Have basic proficiency in Figma and a good understanding of visual communication.
* Create visual concepts and AI\-generated references that can be effectively communicated to designers.



**What We’re Looking For** 



* 2–3 years of experience in digital marketing, content marketing, or a similar role.
* Previous experience in IT services, IT consulting, software development, SaaS, or product engineering.
* Experience working in a startup or fast\-growing technology company is preferred.
* Experience creating content for the US market or US\-focused businesses is preferred.
* Good understanding of IT services such as Software Development, Product Engineering, UI/UX, QA, DevOps, Cloud, AI, and Automation.
* Hands\-on understanding of SEO, keyword research, content marketing, social media, email marketing, and analytics.
* Strong writing, research, communication, and storytelling skills.
* Ability to manage multiple initiatives and work independently.
* Portfolio or work samples are required. Please include a portfolio link in your CV or attach samples of blogs, website content, social media campaigns, newsletters, sales collateral, or other relevant marketing work when applying.



**Good to Have** 



* Hands\-on experience with paid digital marketing, including Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Meta Ads, or other performance marketing platforms.
* Understanding of campaign targeting, lead generation, conversion tracking, and paid campaign performance metrics.

title: Growth Marketing Specialist
description:
**About Company** 




 TechnologyCounter is a leading B2B software discovery and recommendation platform headquartered in Pune, India. We help businesses make informed technology decisions by connecting them with the right software solutions through trusted reviews, detailed comparisons, expert insights, and personalized recommendations. Our platform empowers thousands of organizations to simplify software selection while enabling technology vendors to reach high\-intent buyers through innovative lead generation and digital marketing solutions.
 



 At TechnologyCounter, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. We believe in empowering our people with opportunities to grow, embrace new technologies, and make a meaningful impact. Whether you're beginning your career or advancing to the next level, you'll be part of a dynamic team that values ownership, teamwork, and excellence while working together to shape the future of B2B technology discovery.
 



  





**About the Role** 



* This is a
 **hands\-on marketing role** 
 focused primarily on vendor acquisition and pipeline growth.
* You will be responsible for planning and executing marketing campaigns that generate qualified opportunities from SaaS companies, software vendors, and technology businesses.
* Excellent communication and team\-management skills.
* Ability to work closely with Sales and Leadership teams.
* Comfortable working in a target\-driven and performance\-focused environment.



  





  





**Job Description** 



* Strong understanding of B2B Marketing and Demand Generation.
* Hands\-on experience in Email Marketing and Marketing Automation.
* Strong understanding of Lead Generation and Lead Nurturing.
* Experience planning and executing multi\-channel marketing campaigns.
* Strong understanding of marketing funnels and conversion optimization.
* Experience with CRM and marketing platforms such as HubSpot, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Google Analytics, or similar tools.
* Understanding of SEO, Social Media, Paid Marketing, and Content Distribution.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and team\-management skills.
* Ability to work closely with Sales and Leadership teams.
* Comfortable working in a target\-driven and performance\-focused environment.



  





  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Vendor Acquisition \& Demand Generation** 



* Develop and execute marketing strategies to acquire software and SaaS vendors.
* Identify target industries, personas, decision\-makers, and vendor segments.
* Build multi\-channel campaigns to generate qualified vendor opportunities.
* Target SaaS founders, CMOs, Marketing Heads, Demand Generation Leaders, and other relevant decision\-makers.
* Work closely with Sales to improve lead quality and increase vendor meetings.
* Develop strategies to move prospects through the marketing funnel.








**2\. Email Marketing \& Lead Nurturing** 



* Plan and execute email marketing campaigns for software vendors and B2B technology companies.
* Create audience segments, messaging, nurture sequences, newsletters, and re\-engagement campaigns.
* Promote TechnologyCounter's services, reports, case studies, webinars, guides, and other marketing assets.
* Monitor email performance, engagement, responses, meetings, and conversions.
* Continuously test subject lines, CTAs, messaging, audience segments, and campaign formats.
* Improve marketing automation and lead\-nurturing workflows.








**3\. Campaign \& Content Marketing** 



* Develop monthly and quarterly marketing calendars aligned with vendor acquisition goals.
* Plan campaigns around industry reports, software categories, case studies, webinars, events, and thought leadership content.
* Work with Content, SEO, Social Media, Design, and Video teams to execute campaigns.
* Identify opportunities to repurpose high\-performing content across email, LinkedIn, social media, landing pages, and other channels.
* Ensure marketing content supports business and pipeline objectives.








**4\. Growth Marketing** 



* Identify and test new channels for vendor acquisition.
* Develop LinkedIn, content\-led, ABM, webinar, partnership, and other B2B growth campaigns.
* Optimize landing pages, forms, CTAs, and conversion journeys.
* Test different offers, messaging, campaigns, and audience segments.
* Explore co\-marketing and partnership opportunities with SaaS and technology companies.
* Identify and scale channels that generate high\-quality opportunities.








**6\. Sales \& Marketing Alignment** 



* Work closely with Sales to define the ideal vendor profile and qualification criteria.
* Understand why leads convert or fail to convert.
* Develop campaigns based on Sales feedback and market insights.
* Build nurturing strategies for prospects who are not yet ready to convert.
* Ensure proper lead tracking and handoff between Marketing and Sales.
* Regularly review pipeline quality and improve conversion rates.








**7\. Marketing Analytics \& Performance** 



* Track marketing performance across campaigns and channels.
* Prepare weekly and monthly marketing performance reports.
* Monitor qualified vendor leads, meetings, opportunities, pipeline, conversions, and ROI.
* Track email and landing\-page performance.
* Analyze campaign effectiveness and identify areas for improvement.
* Use data to determine which channels and campaigns should be scaled or optimized.
* Present key insights, challenges, experiments, and next steps to management.



  





**Location: NIBM, Pune** 




**Work Mode: Work from Office** 




**Shift: Day Shift**

title: Senior Performance Marketing Executive
description:
Senior D2C Growth \& Performance Marketing Manager
 
**Location:** 
 Pune (Hadapsar)
 



**Salary:** 
 ₹4–7 LPA
 



**Experience:** 
 2\+ years
 



**Work Mode:** 
 Onsite
 



**Work Timings:** 
 9:30 AM – 6:30 PM \| Alternate Saturdays off
 


 About FarmDidi
 
 FarmDidi is a funded foodtech startup on a mission to empower 1 million\+ rural women while bringing high\-quality, authentic food products to Indian households.
 



 We are building India's next Amul — rooted in purpose, driven by data, and built with relentless execution.
 


* \#1 Pickle Brand on Amazon India
* Featured on Shark Tank India
* Backed by Samved VC, LetsVenture, Indigram Labs and IIM Calcutta
* Recognised by UNDP, NITI Aayog, Wharton Economic Forum, Maharashtra Government and MEITY



 We are a small, ambitious team where every person has real ownership and directly contributes to building the company.
 


 About the Role
 
 We are looking for a
 **Senior D2C Growth \& Performance Marketing Manager** 
 who can own the complete P\&L of our D2C business.
 



 This is not just a performance marketing role.
 



 You will own the commercial performance of the D2C business — including revenue, Meta and Google advertising spends, customer acquisition, CAC, ROAS, AOV, conversion rate, contribution margin and profitability.
 



 You should be someone who genuinely gets excited by
 **Meta Ads, Google Ads, numbers and analysis** 
 .
 



 You should enjoy looking at campaign data and asking:
 


* Why did CAC increase?
* Why did ROAS change?
* Which creative is actually driving conversions?
* Which audience is working?
* Where are customers dropping off?
* What changed from last week?
* What should we test next?
* Where is the next meaningful growth opportunity?



 We are looking for someone who does not simply report numbers, but understands the story behind the numbers and converts analysis into action.
 


 What You Will Own1\. D2C P\&L Ownership
 
 Own the overall performance and profitability of the D2C business, including:
 


* D2C revenue
* Customer acquisition
* Marketing spends
* CAC
* ROAS
* AOV
* Conversion rate
* Repeat purchases
* Contribution margin
* Overall D2C profitability



 You will work closely with the Founders to set monthly and quarterly revenue and profitability targets.
 



 You will not just report numbers.
 



**You will own the numbers.** 



 2\. Meta and Google Ads
 
 You will be the primary owner of FarmDidi's Meta and Google advertising engine.
 



 Responsibilities include:
 


* Own Meta and Google advertising budgets
* Plan and allocate monthly and weekly spends
* Build, manage and optimize campaigns
* Scale winning campaigns
* Identify and fix underperforming campaigns
* Manage CAC and ROAS
* Test audiences, creatives, keywords, placements and campaign structures
* Monitor CPM, CPC, CTR, CVR, CAC and ROAS
* Forecast advertising spends and revenue
* Build performance dashboards and reports
* Identify new opportunities for growth
* Continuously experiment with new campaign formats, tools and strategies



**Hands\-on experience managing Meta and Google Ads spends is mandatory.** 




 We are not looking for someone who has only executed campaigns under supervision. We want someone who has genuinely owned budgets and performance.
 


 3\. Analytics and Growth
 
 We are looking for someone who is
 **highly analytical and genuinely enjoys analysis.** 




 You should enjoy spending time with campaign, customer and business data to identify patterns, problems and opportunities.
 



 You should naturally ask:
 


* Why did CAC increase?
* Why did ROAS drop?
* Which creative is winning and why?
* Which audience is converting?
* Which products are driving profitable growth?
* Where are customers dropping off?
* What changed compared to last week or last month?
* What does the data tell us that we are currently missing?
* What should we test next?



 Your role is not simply to present data.
 



 Your role is to turn:
 



**Data → Insight → Hypothesis → Experiment → Learning → Scale** 



 4\. Content and Creative Strategy
 
 Work closely with the content, creative and brand teams to build content that drives business outcomes.
 



 You will:
 


* Analyse creative performance
* Identify winning creative themes
* Identify winning hooks and messaging
* Develop creative briefs
* Build a continuous creative testing pipeline
* Identify content opportunities based on customer and campaign data
* Translate performance insights into actionable content requirements
* Work with designers, content creators and video teams



 You should be able to look at performance data and tell the content team:
 



**"This is what is working. This is what is not working. Let's create and test multiple variations."** 



 5\. SEO and Organic Growth
 
 Work closely with the SEO and content teams to build sustainable organic acquisition.
 



 You will:
 


* Identify high\-intent search opportunities
* Use Google Ads search data to inform SEO strategy
* Identify content gaps and opportunities
* Improve organic acquisition
* Analyse paid vs organic acquisition
* Identify opportunities to reduce long\-term dependency on paid acquisition


 6\. Shopify and CRO
 
 Work closely with our Shopify developers to improve the D2C funnel.
 



 You will identify and prioritize:
 


* Landing page improvements
* Product page improvements
* Checkout improvements
* Conversion tracking issues
* Pixel and analytics issues
* Page speed improvements
* Funnel drop\-offs
* CRO opportunities
* A/B testing opportunities



 You don't need to be a developer.
 



 But you should be able to clearly communicate:
 



**What is the problem? Why does it matter commercially? What should we fix or test?** 



 7\. Team Management
 
 You will work with and eventually manage members of the growth and performance marketing team.
 



 You should be comfortable with:
 


* Setting goals
* Delegating responsibilities
* Reviewing performance
* Coaching team members
* Building SOPs
* Creating accountability
* Hiring and training talent
* Building a culture of experimentation and performance



 Prior experience managing or mentoring a team is strongly preferred.
 


 What We Are Looking ForMust Have
 * 2\+ years of experience in Performance Marketing, Growth Marketing or D2C
* Strong hands\-on experience with Meta Ads
* Strong hands\-on experience with Google Ads
* Experience managing meaningful advertising budgets
* Experience in D2C, e\-commerce, FMCG, consumer brands or startups
* Strong understanding of CAC, ROAS, CPM, CPC, CTR, CVR, AOV, LTV and contribution margin
* Highly analytical mindset
* Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills
* Experience with GA4 and conversion tracking
* Experience working with Shopify or another e\-commerce platform
* Experience managing or mentoring a team
* Strong communication and problem\-solving skills


 Good to Have
 * Experience owning a D2C P\&L
* Experience managing ₹10L\+ monthly advertising spends
* Experience scaling a consumer brand
* Experience in FMCG, food or consumer products
* SEO / organic growth experience
* CRO and landing page optimization experience
* Experience working closely with content and creative teams
* Experience with Amazon Ads or other digital advertising platforms


 The Person We Are Looking For
 
 You should be:
 



**Highly analytical** 




 Numbers should excite you. You enjoy digging into dashboards, spreadsheets and campaign data to find patterns, anomalies and opportunities.
 



**Curious** 




 You don't simply accept that performance changed. You want to understand why.
 



**Commercially minded** 




 You understand that revenue without healthy contribution margins is not sustainable growth.
 



**Hands\-on** 




 You are comfortable getting into Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads yourself.
 



**Experiment\-driven** 




 You form hypotheses, test quickly, analyse the results and scale what works.
 



**Detail\-oriented** 




 You notice when a metric moves unexpectedly and investigate it.
 



**Ownership\-driven** 




 You don't wait for someone to tell you what to do. You identify problems and take responsibility for solving them.
 



**Fast\-moving** 




 You believe insights should quickly become experiments and experiments should quickly generate learning.
 



**Collaborative** 




 You can work effectively with Founders, content, creative, SEO, Shopify developers and other teams.
 



**A team leader** 




 You can manage, coach and develop people while maintaining high standards.
 



**Always learning** 




 You actively follow the latest developments in Meta, Google, AI, D2C, CRO and performance marketing.
 



 Most importantly, you should genuinely
 **enjoy Meta Ads, Google Ads, numbers and analysis.** 




 If finding a new creative angle, identifying why CAC moved, improving ROAS or discovering a new growth lever genuinely excites you, you will enjoy this role.
 


 How We Will Measure Success
 
 Your success will be measured by business outcomes, not by the number of campaigns launched.
 



 You will be accountable for:
 


* D2C Revenue Growth
* CAC
* ROAS
* Contribution Margin
* New Customer Acquisition
* AOV
* Conversion Rate
* Repeat Purchase Rate
* Organic Revenue Growth
* D2C Profitability



 The goal is to build a scalable and increasingly profitable D2C growth engine for FarmDidi.
 


 Why Join FarmDidi?
 * Work directly with the Founders
* Real ownership from Day 1
* Own a meaningful business P\&L
* Build the growth engine of a rapidly growing consumer brand
* Work across Performance Marketing, Content, SEO, Shopify, CRO and Business Strategy
* 6\-month appraisals
* ESOP opportunity
* High autonomy and fast decision\-making
* Build a business that creates livelihoods for rural women



 You won't just be running ads.
 



**You will be building a business.** 




 If this sounds like you, we would love to hear from you.

title: Alliances Marketing Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Plus Innovations is a cloud\-based innovation platform that helps teams collaborate, share ideas, manage innovation projects, and automate workflows and business processes. The company fosters a vibrant community where innovators work together to create sustainable and progressive solutions that drive positive global change. With a vision of enabling seamless collaboration and impactful innovation for all, Plus Innovations aims to empower 1 billion people to realize their potential. The platform is ISO 27001 certified and recognized by DPIIT under the Startup India initiative, underscoring its commitment to data security, credibility, and national relevance. Potential team members join a mission\-driven organization focused on transforming ideas into meaningful societal impact.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Alliances Marketing Manager is a full\-time, hybrid role based in the Pune Division, with flexibility for some work\-from\-home days. This role is responsible for developing and executing alliance\-focused marketing plans that strengthen partnerships, drive joint campaigns, and increase market visibility for Plus Innovations and its ecosystem partners. The Alliances Marketing Manager will coordinate multi\-channel marketing initiatives, including digital, events, and partner co\-marketing activities, while ensuring consistent messaging and measurable outcomes. Daily responsibilities include collaborating with alliance partners and internal teams, creating marketing assets, tracking campaign performance, and optimizing strategies based on data and partner feedback. title: Performance Marketing Manager
description:
About Redrob AI
 




  






 Redrob AI is building the AI screen of India. Several hundred million Indians will meet artificial intelligence for the first time on a phone rather than a laptop, and most of them will meet it through something that helps them earn more — so that is the thing we are building, and we are building it for them rather than adapting something designed elsewhere. The company is on the road to Series B with products already live and used every day by real people across campuses and cities. Two things define how we work. The first is that we build AI which does the work rather than AI that talks about it: our systems take actions on a person's behalf and are judged on what actually happened, not on how the conversation felt. The second is that we run on measured numbers. Every person here can tell you their one number and where it stands today, decisions get made on a data pull rather than a deck, and we have killed our own favourite plans on the strength of one honest look at the evidence.
 




  






 What Kaabil is
 




  






 Kaabil is a career application that combines two powerful capabilities: an AI agent that reaches out to real recruiters on a candidate's behalf every day, and a system that proves their skills through assessments, guided learning, and verifiable credentials. The two are connected in a continuous loop. Each job shows a match score and identifies the test or learning path that can improve it. Once completed, the credential updates the candidate's resume and improves the agent's future outreach. A single score and progress bar track overall growth, while contests and leagues keep candidates engaged. For institutions, Kaabil helps turn student readiness into measurable progress. Students get unlimited assessments with free retakes, lifetime credential wallets, targeted learning, and weekly readiness visibility for the institution.
 




  





**What you'll own** 




**﻿**

 •
 
**Paid Media:** 

 Own Meta, Google, and YouTube performance, scaling and daily optimisation across the full funnel.
 





 •
 
**App Growth:** 

 Run app install and signup campaigns across Google UAC, Meta App Install, and Apple Search Ads.
 





 •
 
**CAC \& ROAS:** 

 Optimise by channel, audience, cohort, and funnel stage to drive profitable growth.
 





 •
 
**Retargeting:** 

 Recover drop\-offs through retargeting, lookalikes, audience refreshes, and intent\-based campaigns.
 





 •
 
**Creative \& Landing Pages:** 

 Run continuous A/B and multivariate testing across creatives and landing pages.
 





 •
 
**Attribution \& Analytics:** 

 Own tracking and analytics across AppsFlyer, Airbridge, Firebase, and PostHog.
 





 •
 
**ASO:** 

 Improve Play Store and App Store visibility, keywords, listings, and organic installs.
 





 •
 
**Budget Ownership:** 

 Manage monthly spend, justify investments, and eliminate underperforming campaigns.
 





 •
 
**Reporting \& Experimentation:** 

 Maintain a weekly dashboard focused on what to scale, kill, and test next.
 




  





**What good looks like at the end of the quarter** 



* Cost per paying user is below LTV, and you can prove it by cohort rather than in aggregate.
* Blended return on media is above target, and every channel below 1\.0x has either a fix in flight or a kill date.
* Attribution is trustworthy enough that nobody argues about whose number is right in a review.
* Install and signup volume is growing while cost per activation is flat or falling.
* **You'll thrive here if**
* 3–5 years of paid growth experience across Meta and Google for a D2C app or subscription product.
* Proven ownership of app install campaigns, not just web acquisition.
* Experience setting up attribution from scratch and understanding tracking challenges.
* Strong understanding of creative strategy, hooks, and performance testing.
* Data\-driven and confident in cutting underperforming channels and reallocating budget.

 ● Check that the agency's work across every project follows the brand guidelines already in place — logo usage, colors, tone, and tagline.
 



 ● Review the agency's competitor study (pricing, offers, marketing style) every quarter and give inputs on positioning.
 



 ● Guide the agency on who the buyer is for each project (first\-time buyer, investor, NRI, upgrader) so their messaging is targeted correctly.
 



 ● Review and approve the yearly marketing calendar prepared by the agency.
 



  





 2\. Digital Marketing (Online)
 



 ● Review and approve the agency's Google Ads and Meta ad plans — budget, targeting, creatives — before they go live, and check performance regularly.
 



 ● Make sure the website (managed by the agency) stays updated — project pages, price lists, floor plans, and photos.
 



 ● Review the agency's SEO reports and give inputs on what to prioritize.
 



 ● Approve social media content (Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, LinkedIn) before it goes live, and give feedback on quality and tone.
 



 ● Review WhatsApp broadcast content and timing before it's sent out.
 



 ● Make sure every digital ad and post — Google, Meta, social media, website — carries the RERA registration number and required disclaimers, just like print ads.
 



 ● Track the cost per lead and cost per booking the agency reports every month, and question anything that looks off.
 



  





 3\. Offline Marketing (Traditional)
 



 ● Approve hoarding/billboard locations and designs proposed by the agency.
 



 ● Review and approve newspaper ad content and timing.
 



 ● Approve local visibility material — banners, pamphlets, standees — before it's printed.
 



 ● Review the agency's plan for property expos and exhibitions and approve participation.
 



  





 4\. Project Launch Marketing
 



 ● Review the agency's pre\-launch plan teasers, countdown, early\-bird offers and give inputs before it starts.
 



 ● Check the landing page or microsite built by the agency for accuracy before it goes live.
 



 ● Approve the launch day event plan venue, invites, media coverage, giveaways.
 



 ● Review press release drafts and media coverage plans before they go out.
 



 ● Check that the vendor maintains the sample flat/experience center signage and that the walkthrough script stays updated.
 



  





 5\. Channel Partner (Broker) Management
 



 ● Check that brochures, price sheets, and floor plans shared with brokers are accurate and current.
 



 ● Approve broker commission and incentive schemes before they're announced.
 



 ● Review WhatsApp broadcasts to brokers before they go out.
 



 ● Approve broker meet or event plans, and attend the important ones.
 



  





 6\. Property Portal Management
 



 ● Spot\-check listings on 99acres, MagicBricks, Housing.com, NoBroker to make sure they're accurate.
 



 ● Make sure leads coming from these portals are being responded to quickly (same day).
 



 ● Review portal package renewal or upgrade recommendations and approve spend.
 



 ● Track cost per lead by portal, as reported by the agency.
 



  





 7\. Content \& Website
 



 ● Review brochures, price sheets, website, and WhatsApp catalogue content before it's published.
 



 ● Approve ad copy, website content, and social media posts drafted by the agency.
 



 ● Review internal material sales presentations, FAQ sheets, comparison sheets prepared by the agency or sales team.
 



  





 8\. Budget \& Vendor Management
 



 ● Set the marketing budget for each project and channel, with the agency's input, and approve it.
 



 ● Get and compare quotes from agencies and vendors; negotiate rates and approve payments.
 



 ● Track actual spend against budget every month, as reported by the agency, and flag anything off\-track.
 



  





 9\. Site Visits \& On\-Ground Experience
 



 ● Approve drone shoot and walkthrough video plans from the vendor.
 



 ● Check the 360\-degree virtual tour once it's built.
 



 ● Coordinate with the sales team on how site visits are handled.
 



 ● Approve refreshed sample flat staging and signage every few months.
 



  





 10\. Analytics \& Reporting
 



 ● Review the monthly report prepared by the agency leads, site visits, bookings, and cost by channel and question the numbers where needed.
 



 ● Give inputs on shifting budget based on which channels perform best.
 



 ● Present these numbers, with your own inputs added, to the owner or management every month.11\. Team \& Vendor Coordination
 



 ● Brief agencies clearly on what's needed and by when.
 



 ● Review agency output for quality and brand fit before it goes live.
 



 ● Hold regular check\-ins with each agency (design, digital, PR) to track progress.
 



 ● Work closely with the sales head to make sure agency\-generated leads are followed up properly.
 



  





 Skills \& Qualifications
 



 ● 5\-8 years of marketing experience, ideally including time managing agencies or vendors.
 



 ● Comfortable reviewing and giving feedback on both online and offline marketing work, without needing to execute it yourself.
 



 ● Knows RERA rules for real estate advertising is an added advantage but not crucial including what's required on digital ads and social media, not just print so they can catch compliance issues before anything goes live.
 



 ● Good with numbers — able to read agency reports and question them where needed.
 



 ● Strong at briefing, negotiating with, and following up on agencies and vendors.
 



 ● Good at talking to people and explaining ideas clearly.
 



  





 Tools You Should Know
 



 ● Familiar enough with Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, and Google Analytics to read agency reports and ask the right questions — doesn't need to run campaigns personally.
 



 ● Comfortable reviewing creative work (in Canva or similar) and judging quality, even without designing it themselves.
 



 ● Excel/Google Sheets for tracking budgets and reports.
 



 ● Comfortable working in our CRM software — reviewing leads, follow\-ups, and conversion reports the agency shares.

title: Market Performance Manager
description:
At SiteMinder, we believe our success comes from our people. We build diverse, inclusive teams where different voices, backgrounds and perspectives are valued. Our differences drive innovation for our customers, and our people bring the ideas, expertise and energy that help us keep moving forward. We’re better together.
   

  

**What We Do...**
 Right now, somewhere in the world, a hotel is taking a booking or increasing their revenue through technology you could help build. SiteMinder is the world’s leading hotel commerce platform. For more than 20 years, we’ve helped hotels attract guests, maximise revenue, forecast demand and perform at their best. Today, our platform supports 56,000\+ hotels in 150\+ countries, connects to 3,000\+ partners and powers more than 140m reservations and AU$85 billion\+ in hotel revenue each year.
   

  

 That’s the kind of impact your work can have here. You’ll solve meaningful challenges with AI, simplify complexity and build solutions that help hotels perform. Supported by clear purpose, a strong platform and teams who care about what they’re building, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of an industry that never stands still.
   

  

**About The Market Performance Manager Role…**
 The Market Performance Team Manager leads a high\-performing team of Market Performance Team Leads and Specialists who optimise distribution and revenue strategy for our hotel customers. This role is accountable for building and scaling a centre of excellence in market performance — ensuring hotels maximise bookings and profitable revenue through the intelligent use of SiteMinder’s platform, channel mix, and pricing strategies.
   

  

 Combining strategic leadership, deep commercial acumen and strong people management, the Market Performance Team Manager oversees pipeline and performance across all optimisation initiatives, drives capability development in revenue and distribution management, and partners closely with cross\-functional stakeholders to deliver measurable uplift in customer value, retention and revenue outcomes.
   

  

**What You’ll Do…**
* Strategic Leadership: Develop and implement comprehensive market management strategies that maximise product value and drive customer ROI, with a strong focus on revenue and distribution optimisation.
* Team Development \& Leadership: Lead, mentor, and develop Market Performance Team Leads and Specialists. Provide coaching, training and feedback to build deep revenue and distribution optimisation capability across the team.
* Pipeline Management: Own and manage the optimisation and revenue pipeline (initiatives, cases and opportunities), including forecasting, prioritisation and resourcing. Monitor pipeline health, conversion and velocity, and drive continuous improvements in team productivity.
* Performance Reporting: Build and maintain clear performance reporting on optimisation pipeline, revenue impact and team productivity, providing visibility to internal stakeholders and, where appropriate, to customers.
* Distribution Optimisation: Design and oversee strategies that optimise distribution mix (OTAs, direct, GDS and other channels) to drive profitable bookings for hotels. Ensure the team can diagnose channel performance issues and execute corrective actions.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Product, Engineering, Marketing and Sales to ensure market performance and optimisation needs inform product development and go\-to\-market strategies.
* Optimisation Program Design: Create and implement scalable optimisation programs that systematically improve customer outcomes and revenue performance across different tiers and segments.
* Performance Management: Consistently meet or exceed team KPIs. Monitor pipeline, revenue and productivity metrics, and coach Team Leads and Specialists to improve conversion, quality and impact.
* Stakeholder Management: Build strong relationships with key stakeholders across the business. Represent the market performance function in executive forums and champion customer and revenue outcomes.
* Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to enhance optimisation processes, tools and methodologies. Drive innovation in market performance and revenue optimisation delivery to maintain competitive advantage.


**What You Have…**
* Extensive experience in market management at an OTA, customer success, upgrade sales, account management or similar customer\-facing roles, with good experience in a leadership position managing teams (Team Operations).
* Experience leading and developing managers (particularly Team Leads) and frontline specialists, including training and coaching on revenue and distribution optimisation best practices.
* Proven track record of designing and implementing successful market performance and/or optimisation programs that drive measurable revenue and customer outcomes.
* Strong analytical skills with experience using data to inform strategic decision\-making, manage a pipeline and demonstrate ROI (e.g. RevPAR, ADR, occupancy, channel mix, conversion, productivity).
* Solid grounding in hotel revenue management concepts, including demand forecasting, pricing, inventory and channel management, and competitive set analysis.
* Preferable experience optimising distribution strategy and channel mix (OTAs, direct, GDS and other channels) to improve profitability and share.
* Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence at all levels of an organisation. Fluent English required; additional languages (Spanish, German, French, Italian, Thai, Vietnamese, Bahasa, Portuguese or Mandarin) are a plus.
* Strategic mindset with the ability to translate business objectives into actionable market performance and revenue optimisation plans.
* Experience in the hotel industry or travel technology sector is highly desirable; background in Market Performance Management from an OTA is highly beneficial.
* Advanced negotiation skills with the ability to train teams in contract negotiation and value\-based selling.
* Proficient in Salesforce and G\-Suite with ability to analyse data across Salesforce reporting, Tableau (as a reader) and Google Sheets.


**Our Perks \& Benefits…**
* Mental health and well\-being initiatives
* Generous parental (including secondary) leave policy
* Flexibility to work in a Hybrid model (3 days in\-office)
* Paid birthday, study and volunteering leave every year
* Sponsored social clubs, team events, and celebrations
* Employee Resource Groups (ERG) to help you connect and get involved
* Investment in your personal growth offering training for your advancement


 Think this role sounds like you? If so, we’d love to hear from you. Please send us your resume and our Talent Acquisition team will be in touch.
   

  

 When you apply, feel free to share your pronouns and let us know if you need any adjustments during the interview process, we’re here to support you. We also warmly encourage applications from people from underrepresented backgrounds.

title: Senior Analyst - Digital Marketing
description:
Metro Global Solution Center (MGSC) is internal solution partner for METRO, a €31\.6 Billion international wholesaler with operations in more than 30 countries. The store network comprises a total of 623 stores in 21 countries, of which 522 offer out\-of\-store delivery (OOS), and 94 dedicated depots. In 12 countries, METRO runs only the delivery business by its delivery companies (Food Service Distribution, FSD).
   

  

 HoReCa and Traders are core customer groups of METRO. The HoReCa section includes hotels, restaurants, catering companies as well as bars, cafés and canteen operators. The Traders section includes small grocery stores and kiosks. The majority of all customer groups are small and medium\-sized enterprises as well as sole traders. METRO helps them manage their business challenges more effectively.
   

  

 MGSC, location wise is present in Pune (India), Düsseldorf (Germany) and Szczecin (Poland). We provide HR, Finance, IT \& Business operations support to 31 countries, speak 24\+ languages and process over 18,000 transactions a day. We are setting tomorrow’s standards for customer focus, digital solutions, and sustainable business models. For over 10 years, we have been providing services and solutions from our two locations in Pune and Szczecin. This has allowed us to gain extensive experience in how we can best serve our internal customers with high quality and passion. We believe that we can add value, drive efficiency, and satisfy our customers.
   

  

 Website: https://www.metro\-gsc.in

This role supports end\-to\-end digital marketing execution by enabling campaign delivery, content and asset management, channel operations, reporting and performance monitoring across web, app, email and digital channels. Operating within established marketing processes, governance frameworks and service delivery standards, the Digital Marketing Expert contributes to continuous improvement, data quality and consistent execution, working closely with Marketing Team to support digital marketing performance across METRO countries.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Operational:

* Upload graphical content, assets and campaign materials into content management and marketing platforms
* Configure digital content parameters – duration, placement, target groups and store assignments – in line with campaign briefings.
* Set up, test and launch push notifications, newsletters and other customer communications.
* Maintain website content and landing pages, including publishing, unpublishing, redirects and structured data updates
* Build and configure digital and dynamic catalogs, including layout, product hotspots, metadata and audience settings.
* Manage content input from Category Management, Sales, Own Brand, Marketing and external agencies to secure complete and accurate campaign content
* Support in delivering email marketing from newsletter creation, content integration, A/B testing


 Continuous improvement:
   

  

* Identify opportunities to streamline digital marketing execution
* Standardize templates, content structures and operational procedures
* Safeguard data quality, tagging and taxonomy across digital marketing platform


 Collaboration:
   

  

* Partner with local marketing teams, Category Management, Customer Insights and CRM to enable campaign execution
* Work closely with external agencies and freelancers on timely delivery of digital marketing content
* Facilitate alignment on campaign inputs, timelines and content requirements


**Qualifications**
**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Business Administration, Marketing, Communication or a related field preferred
* Minimum 4\-7 years of experience in digital marketing, marketing operations or a related support function
* Experience in retail/wholesale or consumer goods / FMCG is a plus


**Primary Skills (Required)**
* Solid understanding of digital marketing processes across web, app, email and content operations.
* Hands\-on experience with content management, email marketing (experience with Adobe Marketing Automation is a plus) and digital catalog platforms
* Analytical skills to monitor and analyze performance using web analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Looker Studio)
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word); familiarity with CMS and digital marketing tools is a plus
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and work effectively in a remote, collaborative team environment
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and attention to detail
* Fluency in professional English
* Cultural awareness and respect in a multinational, cross\-functional setting


**Secondary Skills (Preferred)**
* Familiarity with tagging, tracking and web analytics concepts (e.g., UTM parameters, campaign tracking)

* Strong aptitude for identifying process improvement opportunities
* Skilled in coordinating cross\-functional inputs and managing stakeholder expectations
* Strong social competence to connect, build networks and support collaboration


**Additional Information**

This is a high\-impact leadership role within our rapidly expanding Global Capability Center (GCC) in Pune.
   

  

 You will lead a multidisciplinary team responsible for CMS and web publishing, email campaigns, social media operations, and publications and content governance. This is not a siloed role. We need a leader who can orchestrate all four workstreams simultaneously, maintain quality across channels, manage stakeholder expectations from Belgium and global markets, and build a team culture of excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.
   

  

 You will be at the centre of building a world\-class marketing operations engine.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**CMS \& Web Publishing \-**
 You will own the end\-to\-end CMS publishing workflow, from intake and briefing through to QA, go\-live, and post\-launch review. You will ensure 95%\+ on\-time delivery and maintain a less than 1% post\-launch error rate across all published assets. You will design and enforce standard operating procedures for briefing, template use, checklist enforcement, and publishing gates. You must have hands\-on experience with our CMS platform (Drupal), ensure all published content meets on\-page SEO standards, and verify layouts and functionality on desktop, tablet, and mobile before every go\-live.
   

  

**Email Campaign Management \-**

description:
What You'll Do
   

  

**Email Marketing Operations Specialist (Pune)**
 Avalara is seeking an experienced Email Marketing Operations Specialist to join our Marketing Operations team. This role owns the end\-to\-end operational excellence of our email and lifecycle marketing programs \- from build and QA through deliverability, governance, and analytics \- to drive pipeline impact at scale.
   

  

**Work Location and Hours**
* Pune office. Collaborate with teams across US and EMEA; occasional evening overlap.


**What Your Responsibilities Will Be**
* Campaign Build \& Orchestration
+ Translate briefs into scalable email journeys (batch, triggered, nurture, ABM) across our MAP (e.g., Marketo/Eloqua/Pardot) and CRM.
+ Build assets, smart lists/segments, programs, and workflows; enforce naming, foldering, and tokens.
+ Partner with stakeholders (Demand Gen, Content, Product Marketing, SDR) to operationalize briefs and SLAs.

* QA, Compliance, and Deliverability
+ Own pre‑send QA: rendering, links, UTM governance, dynamic content, and personalization.
+ Manage preference centers, subscription management, and consent capture to align with CAN\-SPAM, GDPR, CASL, and regional policies.
+ Monitor and optimize deliverability (inbox placement, sender reputation, bounce/complaint rates); manage sender domains, IP warming, DMARC/SPF/DKIM alignment.

* Data, Segmentation, and Hygiene
+ Design audience logic using firmographic, behavioral, and lifecycle signals; maintain suppression/seed/allow lists.

* Testing and Optimization
+ Maintain benchmarks and dashboards for volume, engagement, conversion, and pipeline contribution.

* Platform Ownership and Governance
+ Be a power user and administrator for the MAP and related tools (templates, modules, snippets, preference center, integrations).
+ Create and maintain playbooks, SOPs, QA checklists, and enablement for marketers and SDRs.


 Help manage intake and prioritization with clear SLAs; proactively identify automation opportunities
   

  

 What You’ll Need To Be Successful
   

  

* 3–5\+ years in email/lifecycle marketing operations within B2B SaaS or similar complex environments.
* Deep hands\-on expertise with a leading MAP (Marketo preferred) and strong CRM familiarity (Salesforce); comfortable with APIs/integrations.
* Strong grasp of email deliverability, authentication (SPF/DKIM/DMARC), and regional compliance (CAN‑SPAM/GDPR/CASL).
* Demonstrated rigor in QA, documentation, and governance; ability to simplify complexity and scale best practices.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills across time zones.


**Nice to Have**
* Marketo Certified Expert (MCE) or similar certification.


 Working knowledge of HTML/CSS for email, Litmus
   

  

**Success in 6–12 Months**
* Establish standardized intake, QA, and deployment workflows with \>98% error\-free sends.
* Improve inbox placement and engagement rates to defined benchmarks while reducing complaint/bounce rates.
* Deliver a measurable lift in nurture\-sourced pipeline and velocity through testing and optimization.
* Document and enable reusable templates/modules and a living playbook for global teams.


 Avalara is an AI\-first Company
   

  

 AI is embedded in our workflows, decision\-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.
   

  

* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI\-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges \- improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.


 How We’ll Take Care Of You
   

  

 Total Rewards
   

  

 In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.
   

  

 Health \& Wellness
   

  

 Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.
   

  

 Inclusive culture and diversity
   

  

 Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee\-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.
   

  

**What You Need To Know About Avalara**
 We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.
   

  

 We’ve already built an industry\-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6\.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real \- we're a billion dollar business \- and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission \- to be part of every transaction in the world.
   

  

 We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.
   

  

**We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer**
 Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
Jr. Social Media Manager
 
**Company:** 
 MultiFit Wellness Pvt. Ltd.

 Marketing \& Social Media

 Pune
 



**Experience:** 
 0–2 Years
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**CTC:** 
 ₹30,000 – ₹35,000 per month
 



**Joining:** 
 Immediate Joiners Preferred
 


 About MultiFit
 
 MultiFit Wellness Pvt. Ltd. is a fitness and wellness brand focused on functional fitness, movement, performance, and holistic well\-being. We are looking for a creative and energetic
 **Jr. Social Media Manager** 
 who can take ownership of day\-to\-day content execution and help strengthen MultiFit's digital presence across social media platforms.
 



 This is a highly hands\-on role for someone who enjoys
 **creating content, shooting reels, writing captions and scripts, following social media trends, and being involved in the complete content execution process** 
 .
 


 Role Overview
 
 The Jr. Social Media Manager will support the planning, creation, execution, and management of MultiFit's social media content. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of Instagram and short\-form video content, be comfortable coordinating shoots, and have the creativity to turn fitness, trainers, events, campaigns, and brand stories into engaging digital content.
 



 The role will involve working closely with the marketing, fitness, design, video, and event teams to ensure consistent and engaging content across platforms.
 


 Key Responsibilities1\. Content Creation \& Shooting
 * Ideate and create engaging social media content around fitness, wellness, trainers, workouts, events, offers, and brand initiatives.
* Participate in and coordinate regular content shoots across MultiFit locations.
* Shoot basic videos, reels, stories, behind\-the\-scenes content, and event coverage using smartphones/cameras.
* Identify interesting moments, trends, and stories that can be converted into social media content.
* Work with trainers and internal teams to capture authentic, engaging fitness content.
* Assist in planning shoot requirements, locations, props, talent, and content flow.


 2\. Reels \& Video Execution
 * Create and execute Instagram Reels and other short\-form video content.
* Develop strong hooks and content ideas suited to current social media trends.
* Coordinate the complete reel execution process—from ideation and scripting to shooting, editing coordination, and publishing.
* Understand basic video editing requirements and work with editors wherever required.
* Repurpose existing video content into multiple social media formats.
* Keep track of trending audio, formats, transitions, challenges, and content styles relevant to the fitness and lifestyle industry.


 3\. Social Media Calendar \& Posting
 * Create and maintain weekly/monthly social media content calendars.
* Plan content around brand priorities, campaigns, events, festivals, launches, offers, and important fitness\-related dates.
* Ensure timely posting of reels, posts, carousels, stories, and other content.
* Coordinate with designers, video editors, trainers, and other stakeholders for timely content delivery.
* Maintain consistency in brand tone, visual communication, messaging, and posting frequency.


 4\. Content Writing \& Basic Scripting
 * Write engaging captions, social media copy, hooks, headlines, CTAs, and basic video scripts.
* Develop simple and engaging scripts for reels, trainer videos, educational content, interviews, and campaigns.
* Adapt content according to different social media platforms.
* Proofread content and ensure accuracy before publishing.
* Develop creative content ideas that communicate fitness and wellness concepts in an easy\-to\-understand manner.


 5\. Day\-to\-Day Social Media Management
 * Manage the daily execution of MultiFit's social media handles.
* Schedule and publish approved content.
* Monitor comments, messages, mentions, tags, and audience interactions.
* Coordinate with relevant teams for responses to customer queries or social media interactions.
* Track trending topics and identify opportunities for real\-time content.
* Monitor competitor and industry activity to identify relevant content opportunities.
* Ensure all published content follows MultiFit's brand guidelines.


 6\. YouTube Content Execution
 * Assist in planning and executing YouTube content.
* Coordinate shooting and publishing of YouTube videos, Shorts, trainer content, interviews, workout videos, and event\-related content.
* Write basic titles, descriptions, captions, and content copy for YouTube.
* Repurpose long\-form videos into Shorts and other social media formats.
* Maintain a consistent YouTube content pipeline.


 7\. Events \& Campaign Content
 * Support social media execution for events, fitness challenges, workshops, launches, collaborations, and campaigns.
* Capture real\-time content during events, including stories, reels, interviews, and behind\-the\-scenes footage.
* Coordinate pre\-event, live\-event, and post\-event content.
* Work with the marketing and event teams to ensure campaign communication is executed on time.
* Generate quick\-turnaround content during events and important brand activities.


 8\. Social Media Trends \& Performance
 * Stay updated with Instagram, YouTube, and other relevant platform trends.
* Regularly research trending formats, content styles, sounds, hashtags, creators, and competitors.
* Monitor basic performance metrics such as reach, views, engagement, shares, saves, and follower growth.
* Identify high\-performing content and suggest ideas for improving future content.
* Assist in preparing basic social media performance reports.


 Required Skills
 * Strong understanding of Instagram, Reels, Stories, YouTube, and other major social media platforms.
* Good content ideation and creative thinking skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Basic copywriting and scripting ability.
* Good understanding of short\-form video content.
* Ability to identify and adapt social media trends quickly.
* Basic knowledge of video editing tools such as
 **CapCut, VN, Premiere Pro, Canva** 
 , or similar tools is preferred.
* Basic photography/videography skills will be an advantage.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment and manage multiple content requirements simultaneously.
* Strong coordination and follow\-up skills.
* Good attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines.


 What We Are Looking For
 * Candidates with
 **0–2 years of experience** 
 in social media, content creation, digital marketing, media, or a related field.
* Freshers with a strong portfolio of social media content, reels, college projects, internships, or personal content pages may also be considered.
* Candidates who are comfortable
 **being present at shoots and events** 
 .
* Someone who is highly active on social media and understands what makes content engaging.
* A fitness enthusiast or someone genuinely interested in fitness, wellness, lifestyle, and sports content will be preferred.
* Candidates who can independently take an idea from
 **concept → script → shoot → execution → posting** 
 will have an advantage.
* **Immediate joiners are strongly preferred.**


 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
 * Consistent and timely execution of the social media calendar.
* Number and quality of reels/content pieces executed.
* Reel/video views, reach, engagement, shares, and saves.
* Growth in social media engagement and audience.
* Timely execution of event and campaign content.
* Quality and consistency of captions, scripts, and creative concepts.
* Speed and efficiency of content execution.
* Contribution of content ideas and trend\-based initiatives.
* YouTube and short\-form video content growth.


 Education
 
 A Bachelor's degree in
 **Marketing, Mass Communication, Journalism, Advertising, Digital Marketing, Media, or a related field** 
 is preferred. However, candidates with a strong content portfolio and relevant practical experience may also be considered.
 


 Why Join MultiFit?
 * Opportunity to work with a growing fitness and wellness brand.

title: Brand Strategy & Social Media Intern
description:
Punekar Group is now expanding into the cosmetics and beauty sector through a new consumer venture, The Beautè Project.
 



 The venture is focused on building an affordable premium beauty brand for the next generation of Indian consumers, combining contemporary brand thinking with Indian beauty and wellness knowledge.
 



 At this stage, we are building the fundamentals of the venture, including consumer research, category strategy, brand positioning, communication, social media and go\-to\-market planning.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 The Brand Strategy \& Social Media Intern will work closely with the Founder’s Office on the development of The Beautè Project’s brand strategy, digital presence and marketing initiatives.
 



 The role combines strategic research, consumer insights, content development, social media and execution. The intern will be expected to contribute to how the brand is positioned, communicated and presented to its target audience, while also supporting the execution of day\-to\-day marketing initiatives.
 



 This is a hands\-on role suited to someone who wants exposure to both the strategic and creative sides of brand building, with the opportunity to work across research, campaigns, content, social media and brand development.
 



  





**Role \& Responsibilities** 



* **Brand Strategy \& Market Intelligence:** 
  Conduct structured research across beauty, skincare, cosmetics, wellness and Ayurveda categories; analyse competitors, consumers, emerging trends and market dynamics to identify insights relevant to brand positioning and growth.
* **Brand \& Content Development:** 
  Translate consumer and market insights into brand narratives, content concepts, social media ideas, communication themes and content calendars across relevant digital platforms.
* **Campaign \& Brand Activation:** 
  Support the development and execution of campaigns, product launches, influencer initiatives, photoshoots and other brand\-building activities in coordination with creative teams and external partners.
* **Social Media \& Digital Strategy:** 
  Track relevant social trends, creators, formats and platform developments; contribute to the development of a consistent and differentiated digital presence.
* **Performance \& Business Insights:** 
  Monitor content and campaign performance, identify key learnings and contribute to internal reports, presentations and recommendations for future initiatives.
* **Project \& Stakeholder Coordination:** 
  Work with designers, creators, influencers, vendors and other stakeholders to drive timely execution, manage follow\-ups and maintain quality across multiple projects.



  





**Candidate Profile** 




 We are looking for individuals who demonstrate structured thinking, commercial awareness, creative judgment and a strong bias towards execution.
 


* **Academic Background:** 
  Master’s degree in 
 **Marketing, Management, Business Administration, Communications or a related discipline from a Tier\-1 business school or leading institution** 
 .
* **Strategic \& Analytical Thinking:** 
  Ability to understand a business or marketing problem, conduct structured research and translate observations into clear, actionable insights.
* **Creative \& Consumer Orientation:** 
  Strong interest in brands, consumer behaviour, cosmetics, lifestyle and digital culture, with an ability to identify what makes communication relevant, distinctive and engaging.
* **Communication \& Collaboration:** 
  Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate ideas clearly and work effectively with creative and business stakeholders.
* **Ownership \& Execution:** 
  Takes initiative, manages responsibilities independently, demonstrates strong attention to detail and follows through from idea to execution.
* **Learning Agility:**

title: Head of Marketing
description:
**Overview:** 
 Sellability is on an aggressive, market\-redefining growth trajectory, with development mandates spanning residential, commercial and mixed\-use projects. We're a merit\-driven, entrepreneurial team — the kind of place where ambitious, hard\-working people get real ownership early, not after they've proven themselves for years. At Sellability, you don't just build a job, you build a legacy: fast\-tracked career growth, structured mentorship, exposure to marquee developers, and a direct hand in redefining how real estate is sold and marketed in India.
 



  





 Our projects demand year\-round market activation and sustained brand salience. As we serve an AOP of INR 5000 Cr\+ and growing, Marketing carries a real mandate: project branding, launch and sustenance support, and constant innovation. This role will own consumer and media understanding, inventory\-linked activations, MARTECH adoption, campaign management, SOP creation, AOP strategy, ATL/BTL/Digital coordination, PR and brand communication, and a roadmap across our live markets. About the role: You will be responsible for every brand in our portfolio, across Pune, Mumbai, overseas, and NRI markets. You will plan activations around inventory, run loyalty initiatives timed to project delivery milestones, and build word\-of\-mouth that actually works. You will conceptualize and execute a full communication and activation plan and build the growth strategy that drives demand and new customer acquisition across every channel, from mass and brand campaigns to search, digital, PR, outbound and affiliate marketing. You will fire up every distribution and support vertical needed to move sales across our products and markets.
 



  





 What you will own:
 



  





 Brand Marketing
 



 • Be the custodian of the brand. What Sellability stands for rests on your shoulders, and that's a responsibility we take seriously.
 



 • Keep the brand alive and charismatic. Build campaigns that reinforce what we stand for and bring genuine creativity to how we talk to our customers.
 



 • Drive performance marketing: ideas and initiatives across offline and online campaigns that convert into new registrations, working closely with the performance marketing team. Agency \& Partner Management
 



 • Lead agency relationships with the confidence of someone who has run a top marketing team before. You know how to brief an agency and pull real creative output from them.
 



 • Manage digital influencers and turn them into creative, viral campaigns across social platforms. • Partner with content developers to build strong content across media platforms.
 



 • Handle offline media relationships, both content and advertising. Entrepreneurial Drive
 



 • Bring an entrepreneurial mindset to new initiatives and MARTECH. We've already launched community platforms and educational content platforms for our customers, and there's more to build.
 



 • Lead a team of designers, content writers and external freelancers to deliver stories that do justice to the brand.
 



 • Work cross\-functionally with business and functional teams, translating requirements into crisp, actionable briefs for your team and agencies.
 **Business Ownership** 




 • Build and run the SOPs for your department.
 



 • Own the annual marketing budget and its effective utilisation, including short and long\-term scheduling, media split and resourcing.
 



 • Conceptualise and execute campaigns end to end.
 



 • Plan, execute and monitor all ATL/BTL promotions, marketing database, digital, email, social and display advertising across the portfolio.
 



 • Build growth frameworks for long\-term planning and scalable solutions, while enabling rapid daily experimentation and micro\-optimisation.
 



 • Build team capability across our marketing tech stack, including experimentation, data and CRM platforms.
 



 • Design and run comprehensive test and measurement plans that improve the effectiveness of growth initiatives.
 



 • Build the planning function for growth, defining success metrics and tracking goals at a granular level.
 



  





**What We're Looking For** 




 • 12\-18 years of relevant experience in a dynamic, growing organisation, with strong proficiency across brand marketing, PR, content management, digital and performance marketing.
 



 • Tech savvy, with a strong grip on brand planning, consumer insights, market intelligence, business models and budget management across geographies.
 



 • A strategic mindset that sees the big picture and reads how environmental and organisational change affects the business. • Strong business acumen paired with high EQ.
 



 • Sound judgement, with integrity, compliance and confidentiality as non\-negotiables.
 



 • A self\-starter who can operate independently, set priorities and drive results with minimal supervision.
 



 • Excellent time management and the ability to multi\-task and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
 



 • Meticulous attention to detail while managing multiple stakeholders seamlessly.
 



 • Strong decision\-making with a genuine ownership mindset.
 



 • Someone who leads with process and data but adapts when the situation calls for it. You take initiative, collaborate freely, and care about growing the team and the culture around you as much as the numbers.
 



  





**Why Sellability** 




 • Growth without limits — Real leadership scope from day one: shape the brand strategy for a portfolio scaling toward INR 5000 Cr\+, with direct exposure to marquee developers and large\-scale launches.

In this role, your primary responsibility will be up\-front business consulting, proactive discovery, and strategic advisory. You will lead high\-value presales engagements, shape proactive transformational pitches, and author industry\-specific solutions across Digital Experience, Merchandising, and E\-commerce ecosystems. You will partner closely with Regional Sales Leaders and Technical Solution Architects to accelerate pipeline conversion and position our firm as an elite digital transformation partner.

 Digital Experience: Personalization engines, loyalty frameworks, omnichannel customer journeys, and next\-generation smart\-store tech

* Services Portfolio: Proven track record of winning large\-scale deals in Digital Engineering, Custom Application Development, Cloud Migrations, and Data/Analytics environments

* Consultative Selling: Ability to pivot fluidly from a high\-level business strategy conversation with a retail Chief Marketing/Operating Officer to a technical alignment discussion with a Chief Architect
* Communication \& Presence: Exceptional verbal, written, and narrative storytelling skills. Ability to write clear, compelling proposal responses that avoid technical jargon where appropriate
* Collaborative Mindset: Experience working in a global matrixed environment, seamlessly orchestrating inputs from localized sales reps, technical leads, and shared enablement utilities

**What’s in it for you?**
