title: Director of Product, Platform
description:
**Organization Overview**
**Company Description**
**QAD** 
 is a leading provider of ERP solutions purpose\-built for manufacturing industries — automotive, life sciences, food \& beverage, high tech, and industrial. Serving thousands of global manufacturers, QAD's Adaptive Manufacturing Cloud helps companies operate with greater precision, agility, and intelligence.
   

  

 Enterprise software is entering a third era. The first gave manufacturers a System of Record — ERP that answered 'what do we have and what did we commit to?' The second gave them Data Infrastructure — the ability to move, analyse, and query that data at scale. The third era is domain\-specific intelligence: AI agents that can act autonomously on manufacturing data, but only if that data has been given the context, relationships, and governed rules that allow an agent to reason correctly.
   

  

**ERA — QAD's Enterprise Resource Allocation platform —** 
 is the domain intelligence layer that sits between any ERP and any AI agent. It encodes what manufacturing data means, governs what agents are permitted to do, and makes every autonomous decision traceable and accountable.
   

  

**Job Description**
 This role owns a key pillar of ERA — the Manufacturing Data Fabric \& Intelligence layer. This is the foundational intelligence core: the semantic layer that encodes what manufacturing data means, the metric registry that governs how business outcomes are measured, and the AI Insights and conversational analytics capabilities that surface intelligence to users and agents alike. Without this layer, the rest of ERA cannot function. It is the prerequisite for every downstream agent action, every governed decision, and every autonomous workflow ERA enables.
   

  

 As Director of Product for Data, AI, Reporting \& Analytics, you will report directly to the Head of Platform Product and lead a team of Product Managers and Technical Product Owners. Your scope is the intelligence core — not the integration layer, not the governance engine, not the developer API. You will partner closely with the Directors leading those pillars, but your mandate is singular: make manufacturing data meaningful, queryable, and AI\-ready at enterprise scale.
   

  

 This is a high\-visibility, high\-leverage role. The semantic layer is ERA's primary moat — the hardest layer to build and the one no horizontal AI platform will invest in replicating. Your roadmap decisions will compound over years and directly determine QAD's competitive positioning in the era of autonomous manufacturing.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 The Foundation Exists — The Mandate Now Is To Build ERA's Intelligence Core Into The Definitive Manufacturing Ontology Platform. You Will Have The Scope To
   

  

* Define and own the manufacturing semantic layer — encoding supplier criticality, lead time patterns, quality thresholds, and operational constraints in a form AI agents can reason from
* Build the contextual intelligence layer that passes metric definitions, data distributions, and business rules to LLMs for accurate, anomaly\-aware narrative generation
* Drive QAD's conversational analytics strategy — enabling non\-technical manufacturing users to query operations in natural language without SQL or BI expertise
* Establish the AI evaluation framework that governs quality, accuracy, and latency of every AI\-generated insight shipped to enterprise customers
* Evolve the platform from reactive reporting to proactive, agentic intelligence — where the system surfaces recommended actions, not just data


**Key Responsibilities**
**Platform Strategy \& Roadmap**
* Own the multi\-year product roadmap for ERA's Manufacturing Data Fabric \& Intelligence layer — from raw data pipeline to user\-facing AI insights
* Define the manufacturing semantic layer: encoding metric definitions, operational constraints, supplier relationships, and business rules into a governed ontology that AI agents can reason from
* Translate QAD's ERA vision into concrete, sequenced product bets for the intelligence core — partnering with Directors leading the Integration, Governance, and API pillars to ensure the full platform coheres
* Lead the evolution of AI Insights capabilities: contextual anomaly detection, plain\-language narrative generation, and agentic root cause analysis


**AI \& Conversational Analytics**
* Drive the conversational analytics product — ontology design, knowledge graph, context graph, and intent detection for natural language querying
* Establish and own the AI evaluation framework: latency, accuracy, relevancy gates, LLM\-as\-judge, and human\-in\-the\-loop oversight
* Architect the contextual layer that passes metadata, data distributions, and business rules to LLMs for accurate, enterprise\-grade output
* Define QAD's approach to agentic AI — moving from reactive Q\&A to proactive, action\-triggering intelligence within ERP workflows


**Enterprise Self\-Service Reporting**
* Own the product strategy for self\-service report building — enabling business users across manufacturing, finance, supply chain, and operations to create, customise, and share reports without engineering dependency
* Define the RBAC model for reporting: row\-level and column\-level access controls, report sharing permissions, data scoping by plant, region, and business unit — ensuring enterprise customers can safely deploy self\-service capabilities across large, complex org structures
* Lead the go\-to\-market and rollout strategy for self\-service reporting across B2B industry verticals — working with Customer Success and Solutions Engineering to drive adoption, define onboarding playbooks, and reduce time\-to\-value for enterprise deployments
* Set the product bar for enterprise\-grade report authoring: scheduling, export, embedding, white\-labelling, and audit trails that meet the compliance and operational needs of regulated industries
* Establish feedback loops with enterprise customers to continuously refine the self\-service experience — tracking adoption metrics, identifying capability gaps, and prioritising the roadmap against real user workflows


**Data Infrastructure \& Intelligence**
* Partner with Engineering to define the data lake, pipeline, and event architecture that underpins ERA's intelligence layer — optimising for AI\-readiness, scale, and cost efficiency
* Own the metric registry and semantic data model — ensuring consistent, governed definitions of manufacturing KPIs across all ERA consumers
* Collaborate with the Governance \& Compliance pillar to ensure intelligence outputs meet enterprise compliance requirements; own the data quality and freshness standards within your layer
* Define monetization strategy for intelligence platform capabilities including governed data exports, delta sharing, and partner integrations


**GTM, Sales \& Market Enablement**
* Act as the product authority for Sales and Marketing on ERA's Data, AI, and Analytics capabilities — providing positioning, messaging, and competitive differentiation across the full intelligence layer, not just reporting
* Partner with GTM teams to develop selling motions for AI Insights, conversational analytics, and self\-service reporting — translating platform capabilities into clear business value narratives for manufacturing buyers
* Build and maintain sales enablement assets: demo environments, capability decks, objection\-handling guides, and ROI frameworks that equip field teams to position the intelligence layer confidently
* Engage with Marketing on thought leadership, analyst relations, and campaign strategy — ensuring QAD's AI and analytics narrative reflects the depth and differentiation of what the platform can actually deliver
* Work with Solutions Engineering and Pre\-Sales on complex enterprise deals — providing product depth in discovery, RFP responses, and proof\-of\-concept engagements where the intelligence layer is a key differentiator


**Customer Discovery \& UX Partnership**
* Maintain a structured and continuous customer discovery programme — conducting regular interviews, site visits, and advisory sessions with manufacturing customers across segments and geographies
* Translate customer discovery into sharp problem definitions and validated hypotheses before committing roadmap resources — ensuring the team builds what the market needs, not what it assumes
* Serve as a named executive contact for key enterprise customers and design partners; build relationships that provide early access to real workflows, pain points, and adoption barriers
* Partner closely with UX and Design from problem framing through to launch — ensuring the intelligence layer is not just technically capable but genuinely usable by non\-technical manufacturing users
* Champion the user in internal prioritisation debates; bring customer evidence — not opinion — to roadmap and trade\-off discussions


**Leadership \& Stakeholder Management**
* Lead and grow a team of PMs and TPOs; create a high\-performance, execution\-focused product culture with strong discovery and delivery discipline
* Drive alignment across Product, Engineering, UX, Customer Success, Sales, and Executive leadership on platform priorities and sequencing
* Represent the Data, AI \& Analytics platform in senior leadership forums, including roadmap reviews with the President's office


**Qualifications**
**Experience**
* 15\+ years in product management, with significant time in data platforms, analytics, or AI/ML products in enterprise SaaS environments
* Proven track record owning 0\-to\-1 and scale\-up AI Insights or analytics platforms — from early access through enterprise GA
* Experience in ERP, CRM, or broader B2B enterprise software; deep familiarity with the data needs of complex enterprise operations
* Demonstrated ability to drive measurable outcomes: user growth, CSAT improvement, cost optimization, and revenue expansion through platform capabilities
* Prior experience working directly with Sales, Pre\-Sales, and Marketing to build GTM motions and enablement for platform or data products — not just handing off a roadmap but actively participating in market positioning and deals
* History of structured customer discovery practice — conducting interviews, running advisory boards, or embedding with customers to build evidence\-based roadmaps


**Technical Depth**
* Hands\-on fluency with: LLM evaluation frameworks, semantic layer design, knowledge graphs, RAG architectures, conversational analytics, and agentic AI
* Strong command of data platform architecture: Snowflake, Databricks, delta sharing, ETL/ELT, event\-driven pipelines, federated search
* Ability to engage deeply with engineering on infrastructure trade\-offs — pipeline cost, performance at scale, and AI feature architecture
* Working knowledge of SQL, data modelling, and API design sufficient to hold authoritative technical conversations


**Leadership \& Communication**
* Director\-level leadership maturity: translates business strategy into functional plans, reconciles multi\-stakeholder views, and drives execution across matrixed organizations
* Comfortable operating on complex, ambiguous problems where established frameworks don't apply — defines the approach, not just follows one
* Makes decisions with long\-horizon awareness; understands that platform architecture choices compound over years and plans accordingly
* Proven experience building and scaling product teams; consistent track record of developing strong PMs and fostering a culture of ownership
* Excellent executive communication — makes complex platform decisions accessible to non\-technical senior leaders and enterprise customers alike
* Actively engages with major customers and cross\-functional leaders; able to negotiate priorities and build consensus across competing stakeholder views
* Strong collaborator with UX and Design — understands that intelligence platform adoption lives or dies on usability, not just capability


**Preferred Background**
* Prior experience at enterprise SaaS companies scaling AI/analytics platforms to multi\-thousand customer deployments
* Familiarity with manufacturing ERP data models, production operations, or supply chain analytics is a strong plus
* Experience defining and owning monetization strategy for data or AI platform features
* Patents, publications, or open\-source contributions in AI, data infrastructure, or analytics are valued


**Why This Role at QAD**
* Direct impact: Your roadmap decisions will shape AI capabilities used by thousands of manufacturers worldwide
* Strategic mandate: This is not a maintenance role — it is a build mandate at the intersection of AI, data, and enterprise ERP
* Executive visibility: You will operate at the centre of QAD's platform transformation, with direct access to the President's office and cross\-functional leadership
* Pune platform hub: QAD is actively expanding its platform engineering and product capabilities in India — you will be a founding voice in that growth


**Additional Information**

* Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation.
* Collaborative culture of smart and hard\-working people who support one another to get the job done.

title: Manager, Product Development - EMV and Payment Technology
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Manager, Product Development \- EMV and Payment Technology
   

  

**Overview**
 Mastercard delivers robust, high quality, and fully approved technology products that enable issuers, acquirers, and partners to bring secure and innovative payment solutions to market.
   

  

 Within the Chip Engineering organization, the Product Approval Team plays a critical role in ensuring that these products—ranging from cardholder and acceptance devices to Wallet UIs, mobile applications, and back end systems—meet Mastercard standards and are delivered on time.
   

  

 This role provides the opportunity to work globally across a wide spectrum of products, including device\-based solutions, wearables, mobile payment applications, cloud based payment systems, transit solutions, and backend services.
   

  

 \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
   

  

 Major Responsibilities
   

  

 Operational Management
   

  

* Lead and manage operations related to Mobile Payment Applications, Wallet UI, Wearables, and Back\-End Server Approvals.
* Ensure full compliance with Mastercard testing, branding, approval processes, and operational rules.
* Oversee the execution of global approval processes and associated requirements for:
* Wallet UI and Wearables
* Merchant Presented QR (MPQR)
* Cloud\-Based Payments (MCBP)
* Token Service Providers (TSP)
* Trusted Service Managers (TSM) for SE/TEE\-based solutions
* Link with MDES, GVCP and PCI teams to ensure all pre\-requisites are met
* As a backup, manage operations related to Tap\-on\-phone Product Approvals


 Vendor, Partner \& Customer Engagement
   

  

* Act as a primary interface with key external partners, vendors, developers, and customers.
* Organize and lead weekly calls with stakeholders to track progress and resolve issues.
* Manage modifications to vendor contracts or agreements, engaging legal when required.


 Accredited Laboratory Management
   

  

* Manage the Global Test Bench Identifier (GTBI) tool and ensure timely delivery to labs.


 Data, Reporting \& Process Automation
   

  

* Maintain product approval databases and tracking files, proposing and implementing continuous improvement ideas.
* Implement AI/Agent in our daily support activities and operations (when possible).
* Visual Basic developments to automate workflows and accelerate approval operations.
* Provide management with quarterly reports covering SLAs, approval volumes, KPIs, and key statistics.
* Manage bi\-weekly internal approved products report
* Manage publications on Mastercard Connect
* Contribute to communiqués outlining process changes and enhancements.


 Regional Support
   

  

* Support Mastercard Regional teams regarding product approval processes and product migration topics.


 \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
   

  

**Required Skills \& Experience**
 Education
   

  

* University degree in Engineering or equivalent practical experience; advanced degree preferred.


 Professional Background
   

  

* 9\+ years’ experience in quality assurance, project management, or business process engineering.
* Industry exposure in one or more of the following: software development, financial services, telecom/mobile, e commerce.


 Technical \& Domain Expertise
   

  

* Strong understanding of digital payment systems.
* In depth knowledge of chip card technology and EMV specifications.
* Familiarity with testing and approval methodologies is essential.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Access; Visual Basic development experience required.


 Core Skills
   

  

* Excellent analytical and business writing skills.
* Strong project management capabilities with the ability to lead cross\-functional initiatives without direct authority.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and global stakeholder relationships.
* Business acumen and ability to provide solutions while managing customer expectations.
* Strong presentation and communication skills, with clarity in explaining concepts and processes.
* Self motivated with a strong record of success in team\-based environments.
* Excellent command of English (Mandarin if possible), both spoken and written.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Director Product Management - Source-to-Pay
description:
**Organization Overview**
**Company Description**
 QAD is a leading provider of adaptive, cloud\-based enterprise software and services for global manufacturing companies. At QAD, we help customers transform and innovate through modern cloud platforms, data\-driven insights, and AI\-enabled solutions. Our Engineering organization plays a critical role in delivering resilient, scalable, and high\-quality platforms that power customer success worldwide.
   

  

**Job Description**
 QAD is looking for a senior product leader to own and advance our Procure\-to\-Pay and Supplier Relationship Management product strategy for manufacturers.
   

  

 This role will lead the end\-to\-end product vision for supplier\-facing workflows across sourcing, supplier onboarding, supplier collaboration, purchase order execution, supplier risk, procurement automation, invoice collaboration, and AI\-powered decisioning. The objective is to build a modern, workflow\-led procurement suite that helps manufacturers improve supply continuity, reduce supplier risk, control material costs, and automate manual procurement work.
   

  

 This is not a traditional module\-owner role. We are looking for a product leader who can think across the full manufacturing procurement workflow, connect SRM with ERP execution, and define how AI agents can help procurement teams move from reactive follow\-up to proactive supplier and supply\-chain decisioning.
   

  

 The role will work closely with engineering, AI, platform, sales, services, customer success, and executive leadership to shape the roadmap, commercial packaging, customer adoption, and long\-term product differentiation.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Own the Procure\-to\-Pay and Supplier Intelligence Product Strategy**
* Define the product vision and roadmap for QAD’s Procure\-to\-Pay, SRM, supplier collaboration, and supplier intelligence capabilities.
* Build a clear product strategy that connects SRM, sourcing, supplier management, PO collaboration, invoice workflows, ERP execution, and AI agents.
* Identify the highest\-value manufacturing procurement use cases, including supplier delay handling, supplier risk management, sourcing optimization, purchase order change management, and supplier performance improvement.
* Translate customer pain points into differentiated product capabilities and commercially compelling offerings.
* Partner with GTM teams to position SRM and Procure\-to\-Pay as a strategic workflow suite for manufacturers.


**Lead End\-to\-End Workflow Product Management**
* Own the complete Source/Procure\-to\-Pay workflow from supplier discovery and onboarding through sourcing, PO execution, supplier collaboration, receiving, invoice matching, and supplier performance.
* Work across ERP, SRM, procurement, supply chain, quality, finance, and AI teams to ensure the workflow is connected end to end.
* Identify where procurement users experience friction, manual work, poor visibility, or delayed decisions, and turn those into roadmap priorities.
* Create clear product requirements, workflow maps, customer journeys, and measurable business outcomes.
* Drive alignment between workflow needs, platform capabilities, integrations, data model, and user experience.


**Build AI Agent And Decision Service Capabilities**
* Define how AI agents should support procurement users across sourcing, supplier collaboration, exception handling, risk monitoring, and decision support.
* Identify agent use cases that can reduce manual follow\-up, improve supplier responsiveness, recommend alternatives, and accelerate procurement decisions.
* Partner with AI and data teams to define the context, permissions, guardrails, workflows, and approval paths required for safe agent execution.
* Build capabilities that move from insight to recommendation to governed action.
* Help define procurement\-related Decision Services, starting with high\-value use cases such as supplier delay handling and supplier risk response.


**Drive Customer and Market Understanding**
* Spend significant time with manufacturing customers, procurement leaders, supply chain leaders, finance leaders, and suppliers to understand real\-world workflows.
* Develop a strong point of view on direct materials procurement, supplier collaboration, supplier quality, risk, and cost management.
* Understand competitive offerings across SRM, source\-to\-pay, direct procurement, supplier collaboration, and procurement orchestration.
* Use customer feedback, win/loss insights, product analytics, and market research to shape roadmap priorities.
* Partner with sales and customer success to improve adoption, attach, retention, and expansion.


**Partner Across the Business**
* Work with engineering to deliver scalable, reliable, and configurable product capabilities.
* Work with platform and integration teams to ensure procurement workflows connect cleanly with ERP, finance, supplier, and third\-party systems.
* Work with sales and marketing to create clear messaging, packaging, demos, and value stories.
* Work with services and customer success to simplify implementation and accelerate customer outcomes.
* Provide executive\-level visibility into roadmap, adoption, risks, and investment priorities.


**What Success Looks Like**
**In the first 6 months, success will include:**
* Clear product strategy and roadmap for Procure\-to\-Pay, SRM, supplier collaboration, and AI agents.
* Prioritized set of high\-value procurement workflows and Decision Services.
* Strong alignment across product, engineering, AI, sales, services, and customer success.
* Customer\-validated use cases for supplier delay handling, supplier risk, sourcing, and PO collaboration.
* Clear commercial positioning for SRM and Procure\-to\-Pay in manufacturing accounts.


**In The First 12 Months, Success Will Include**
* Delivery of meaningful workflow improvements that reduce manual procurement effort and improve supplier visibility.
* Initial AI agent capabilities embedded into procurement workflows.
* Increased SRM attach and adoption across targeted customer segments.
* Stronger product differentiation for QAD in direct materials and manufacturing procurement.
* A repeatable roadmap and operating model for workflow\-led product management.


**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of product management experience in enterprise software.
* Well\-versed in AI PDLC
* 4\+ years of experience in procurement, source\-to\-pay, procure\-to\-pay, SRM, supplier collaboration, supply chain, ERP, or related enterprise workflows.
* Strong understanding of direct or complex procurement processes, ideally in manufacturing.
* Experience building products that span multiple users, systems, workflows, and approval paths.
* Ability to translate complex business processes into simple, scalable product experiences.
* Strong customer discovery, roadmap planning, prioritization, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience working closely with engineering teams in an agile product development environment.
* Ability to influence cross\-functional teams without relying only on formal authority.
* Strong executive communication skills and ability to simplify complex topics for senior audiences.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with direct materials procurement, BOM\-driven sourcing, supplier collaboration, supplier risk, supplier quality, or manufacturing supply chains.
* Experience with enterprise ERP systems such as QAD, SAP, Oracle, Infor, Epicor, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar platforms.
* Experience with SRM, source\-to\-pay, procurement orchestration, AP automation, supplier portals, or supplier networks.
* Experience building AI, automation, workflow, or decision\-support capabilities.
* Experience working with mid\-market or enterprise manufacturers.
* Experience from companies in procurement, supply chain, ERP, or manufacturing software.


**Ideal Candidate Profile**
 The ideal candidate has built enterprise procurement or supplier collaboration products and understands the difference between generic P2P automation and manufacturing procurement execution.
   

  

 They should be comfortable talking to a procurement leader about supplier risk, a plant leader about material shortages, a CFO about working capital and cost, an IT leader about ERP integration, and an AI team about how agents should safely act inside procurement workflows.
   

  

 They are strategic enough to define the future of the suite, but hands\-on enough to write product requirements, run customer discovery, inspect workflows, challenge engineering trade\-offs, and help sales win deals.
   

  

**Key Attributes**
* Strong ownership mindset.
* Deep curiosity about manufacturing and procurement workflows.
* Ability to operate across strategy and execution.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and transformation.
* Strong commercial instincts.
* Clear communicator.
* Customer\-backward thinker.
* Practical approach to AI and automation.
* Bias toward measurable business outcomes.


**Additional Information**
* Your health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work\-life balance.
* Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation.
* Collaborative culture of smart and hard\-working people who support one another to get the job done.

 ₹50,000–₹80,000/month \+ performance incentives
 **up to ₹5 lakh** 




  





 About the Role
 



 We are looking for a
 **performance marketer who is obsessed with numbers, experiments and growth.** 




**Someone who doesn't just know how to** 
*run Meta Ads* 
 — but understands
 **why an ad wins, why it loses, how many creatives to test, which audiences to explore, when to kill an ad, when to scale it, and how to turn paid acquisition into a predictable growth engine. Meta should be your deepest area of expertise** 
 .
 



 You should have experience scaling a brand or working with an agency where you have managed significant budgets and contributed to
 **$1M\+ in attributable revenue** 
 or equivalent scale, with a strong understanding of ROAS, CAC, contribution margin and profitability.
 



  





  





 What you'll own:
 



  





 1\. META ADS — THIS IS YOUR CORE JOB
 



 You will own the entire Meta performance engine.
 



 Not just campaign execution.
 



 You will be responsible for:
 


* Campaign architecture and account structure
* Prospecting vs retargeting strategy
* Audience discovery
* Broad vs interest vs lookalike strategies
* Creative testing frameworks
* Hook testing
* Copy testing
* Offer testing
* Landing\-page testing
* Budget allocation
* Campaign scaling
* Retargeting
* Frequency management
* CAC / ROAS optimisation
* Attribution analysis
* Daily performance monitoring
* Weekly growth analysis



  





 You should be able to answer questions like:
 



**How many creatives should we launch this week?Which 5 audiences should we test next and why?When do you kill an ad?When do you increase budget by 20%, 50% or 2X?Is the problem the creative, audience, offer, landing page or product?Why did CPM increase?Why is CTR falling?Why is Meta giving us cheap clicks but expensive purchases?What is our real CAC after considering contribution margin?** 




  





  





 2\. Build a creative testing machine:
 



 You will work closely with the creative team to create a systematic testing engine.
 



 You will decide:
 


* What creatives need to be made
* How many variants to test
* Which hooks to test
* Which angles to test
* Which formats to test
* Which audience each creative is intended for
* Which winning creatives should be scaled
* Which losers should be killed



 For example:
 



**10 hooks × 3 visual executions × 2 offers** 




 should not be random experimentation.
 



 You should be able to build a
 **structured testing matrix** 
 and understand which variable is actually driving performance.
 



  





**3\. Creative Intelligence** 




 You won't just consume creatives.
 



 You'll help
 **create them.** 




 You should be comfortable with:
 


* Canva
* AI image generation
* AI video tools
* ChatGPT
* AI copywriting tools
* Basic Photoshop / Figma is a plus
* Meta Creative tools
* Rapid static ad creation



 You should be capable of saying:
 



 “This concept needs to be tested today.”
 



 …and then actually making a usable first version yourself rather than waiting two days for a designer.
 



  





**4\. Google Ads** 




 You will also manage / work closely on:
 


* Google Search
* Performance Max
* Shopping
* Brand vs non\-brand
* Keyword research
* Search intent
* Negative keywords
* Conversion tracking
* Budget allocation
* ROAS / CAC optimisation
* Landing\-page optimisation



 Meta will be your
 **specialisation** 
 ; Google should be a strong secondary capability.
 



  





**5\. Amazon Ads** 




 Hands\-on experience with Amazon advertising is required.
 



 You should understand:
 


* Sponsored Products
* Sponsored Brands
* Sponsored Display
* Keyword strategy
* Search term analysis
* Product targeting
* Competitor targeting
* Amazon ROAS / TACoS
* Organic \+ paid interaction
* Product detail page optimisation



  





**6\. Quick Commerce** 




 Experience with platforms such as:
 


* Blinkit
* Zepto
* Swiggy Instamart
* Amazon Fresh / other relevant platforms



 You should understand how paid visibility, search placement, product availability, pricing, promotions and conversion interact on quick\-commerce platforms.
 



  





**7\. Competitor \& Market Intelligence** 




 This is another area I would make a
 **core responsibility** 
 , because it differentiates this role.
 



 You should constantly be researching:
 



**Competitor Ads** 



* What are competitors advertising?
* Which creatives are they repeatedly running?
* What hooks are they using?
* What offers are they pushing?
* Which products are they promoting?
* How are they positioning themselves?



**Competitor Products** 



* Pricing
* Bundles
* Offers
* Reviews
* Ratings
* Product positioning
* Claims
* Landing pages
* Amazon listings



**Audience Intelligence** 



* Who are competitors speaking to?
* What problems are they addressing?
* What objections are consumers raising?
* What language are customers using?



**Tools** 




 You should be comfortable using relevant tools such as:
 


* Meta Ads Library
* Similarweb
* SEMrush / Ahrefs
* Google Trends
* Amazon research tools
* Social listening tools
* Ad intelligence platforms
* Competitor tracking tools
* AI research tools



**You don't need to know every tool. You need to know how to find the answer.** 




  





**8\. Data \& Analytics** 




 You should live inside numbers.
 



 Track and analyse:
 



**CTR** 




**CPC** 




**CPM** 




**Hook Rate** 




**Hold Rate** 




**CVR** 




**CAC** 




**CPA** 




**AOV** 




**ROAS** 




**MER** 




**LTV** 




**Contribution Margin** 




**Frequency** 




**iROAS** 




 And importantly:
 



**Understand the relationship between them.** 




 For example:
 



 CPM ↑ → CTR ↓ → CPC ↑ → CVR ↓ → CAC ↑
 



 You should be able to identify
 **where the actual problem is** 
 instead of simply saying:
 



 “Meta performance has gone down.”
 



  





**9\. Scaling** 




 We are specifically looking for someone who has
 **actually scaled campaigns** 
 , not someone who has only managed ₹2–5 lakh/month budgets.
 



 You should have experience with:
 


* Scaling winning campaigns
* Increasing spend without destroying efficiency
* Creative fatigue
* Audience saturation
* Budget reallocation
* Geographic expansion
* New product launches
* New customer acquisition
* Retention / remarketing
* Scaling from ₹X/day → ₹X lakh/day



 We want someone who can demonstrate:
 



**“This was the starting point.** 




**This was the budget.** 




**This was the CAC/ROAS.** 




**This is what I changed.** 




**This is where we reached.”** 




  





**10\. Build the Performance Marketing Dashboard** 




 You will own weekly performance reporting.
 



 Not vanity reports.
 



 Every week you should be able to tell the founders:
 



**WHAT HAPPENED?** 




**WHY DID IT HAPPEN?** 




**WHAT DID WE LEARN?** 




**WHAT ARE WE TESTING NEXT?** 




**WHERE SHOULD WE PUT MORE MONEY?** 




**WHERE SHOULD WE STOP SPENDING?** 




  





**The Person We Are Looking For** 




**You might be the right person if:** 



* You genuinely enjoy Meta Ads.
* You spend time inside Ads Manager even when nobody asks you to.
* You understand creative performance.
* You obsess over CAC and ROAS.
* You have personally scaled campaigns.
* You know how to structure experiments.
* You understand audiences deeply.
* You are comfortable with large budgets.
* You can work with founders directly.
* You can create a quick ad yourself.
* You use AI to accelerate your workflow.
* You are constantly researching competitors.
* You are uncomfortable making decisions without data.



**You are probably NOT the right person if:** 



* Your primary skill is simply campaign setup.
* You outsource every creative decision.
* You only know boosted posts.
* You cannot explain why an ad won.
* You have never personally scaled spend.
* You report impressions and reach but don't understand unit economics.
* You need someone else to tell you what to test.



  





**Mandatory Experience** 




 I'd make these requirements quite specific:
 



**Required:** 



* 3–7 years performance marketing experience
* Strong hands\-on Meta Ads experience
* Experience with either a
 **D2C brand or performance marketing agency**
* Demonstrated experience managing substantial advertising budgets
* Experience contributing to
 **$1M\+ in attributable revenue / GMV**
* Strong understanding of CAC, ROAS, LTV and contribution margin
* Google Ads experience
* Amazon Ads experience
* Quick\-commerce advertising experience
* Canva \+ AI creative tools
* Strong analytical skills
* Competitor research / ad intelligence experience



**Preferred:** 



* Food / FMCG / nutrition / wellness / beauty / D2C experience
* Experience scaling a consumer brand
* Experience launching a new product from zero
* Experience working directly with founders
* Basic design/video editing ability
* Strong understanding of landing\-page CRO

description:
Sales \& Marketing Intern
   

 Company: Indux Technology

 Internship Type: Remote
   

 About Indux Technology
   

 Indux Technology is a technology\-focused company delivering digital solutions and real\-world technology projects. The internship program is designed to give students and freshers practical exposure, professional work habits, team collaboration, and role\-specific experience while contributing to company initiatives.
   

 About the Internship
   

 We are looking for motivated candidates for the Sales \& Marketing Intern position. This 6\-month internship is intended for candidates who want to build practical skills through real\-world work, guided learning, feedback, and consistent contribution. Support customer acquisition through prospect research, lead generation, outreach, follow\-ups, digital marketing, campaign execution, and sales support.
   

 Role Description
   

 As a Sales \& Marketing Intern, you will work with the relevant team to support assigned projects and operational activities. You will be expected to learn quickly, follow professional processes, complete assigned responsibilities, and progressively take greater ownership of your work.
   

 Key Responsibilities
   

 Identify target customers, industries, companies, and business opportunities.
   

 Generate leads through LinkedIn, email, social media, online research, and other channels.
   

 Assist with cold calling, cold emailing, LinkedIn outreach, and follow\-ups.
   

 Promote Indux Technology services and understand prospect business requirements.
   

 Qualify leads and maintain accurate lead status and communication history.
   

 Schedule meetings and support the sales team with prospect coordination.
   

 Assist with sales presentations, proposals, quotations, and marketing materials.
   

 Support social media and digital marketing activities that contribute to lead generation.
   

 Research competitors, customer needs, market trends, and new opportunities.
   

 Maintain CRM records and track outreach, follow\-ups, meetings, and outcomes.
   

 Collaborate with sales, marketing, content, design, and technical teams.
   

 Monitor campaign/outreach performance and suggest practical improvements.
   

 Maintain professional communication and represent the company appropriately.
   

 Skills \& Requirements
   

 Good communication and interpersonal skills.
   

 Interest in sales, marketing, business development, and technology.
   

 Basic knowledge of lead generation, customer acquisition, and digital platforms.
   

 Familiarity with LinkedIn, email, CRM, and social media is preferred.
   

 Good research, follow\-up, organization, and relationship\-building skills.
   

 Confidence to communicate with prospects professionally.
   

 Target\-oriented, proactive, and willing to learn.
   

 Students and freshers are welcome.
   

 Performance Expectations
   

 Consistent completion of assigned tasks with acceptable quality.
   

 Ability to learn from feedback and demonstrate measurable improvement.
   

 Professional communication and timely response to team members.
   

 Reliability, discipline, ownership, and adherence to deadlines.
   

 Positive contribution to team goals and willingness to take initiative.
   

 Role\-specific performance and contribution during the internship.
   

 What You Can Gain
   

 Practical exposure to real\-world projects and professional workflows.
   

 Hands\-on experience relevant to the selected role.
   

 Opportunity to build projects, work samples, and a professional portfolio where applicable.
   

 Guidance, feedback, collaboration, and exposure to cross\-functional teams.
   

 Internship Completion Certificate, subject to successful completion and company policy.
   

 Letter of Recommendation (LOR), where applicable and based on performance/conduct.
   

 Opportunity to be considered for performance\-based continuation from Month 7\.
   

 If selected for continuation, an opportunity for a stipend of ₹1,000–₹15,000/month based on performance.
   

 Important Internship Terms
   

 The first six months are strictly unpaid; no stipend is payable during Months 1–6\.
   

 The internship does not guarantee a job, paid employment, stipend, or continuation after six months.
   

 Continuation from Month 7 is selective and depends on performance, business requirements, availability, and management approval.
   

 A stipend, if offered from Month 7, will be decided individually within the ₹1,000–₹15,000/month range.
   

 Interns must maintain confidentiality and must not share company/client information, source code, credentials, documents, or internal data without authorization.
   

 Interns are expected to follow company policies, assigned working schedules, deadlines, meeting requirements, and reasonable instructions from managers/mentors.
   

 How to Apply

 hr@induxtechnology.com
   

 Apply now and begin your practical career journey in Sales \& Marketing with Indux Technology.

 This role is for someone who understands that performance marketing is not just about running campaigns — it is about understanding customers, building scalable acquisition funnels, improving conversion and driving profitable growth.
   




 Role Overview
   


 You will own Mealawe’s performance marketing engine across Meta, Google, YouTube and LinkedIn while working closely with Product, UI/UX, Design, Technology, Sales and Operations teams.
 



 Your primary focus will be:
 


* Growing Mealawe subscriptions
* Scaling Mealawe Apartment Model acquisition
* Improving customer acquisition efficiency
* Building repeatable growth systems



 You should be comfortable working in a startup environment where speed, experimentation and measurable outcomes matter.
 



  





  




 Key Responsibilities
   

 Performance Marketing \& Customer Acquisition
   

* Own and optimise paid acquisition campaigns across:
* Meta Ads (Facebook \& Instagram)
* Google Ads
* YouTube Ads
* LinkedIn Ads
* Plan and execute campaigns focused on:
* Subscription acquisition
* Trial conversions
* Apartment resident acquisition
* New city launches
* Customer growth
* Manage complete campaign lifecycle:



 Customer Research → Campaign Strategy → Creative Testing → Launch → Optimisation → Scaling
 


* Own and improve key growth metrics:
* CAC
* CPA
* CPL
* ROAS
* Conversion Rate
* Subscription Acquisition Cost
* Customer Quality
* Retention



  





  




 Funnel Optimisation \& Growth Experiments
   

* Analyse the complete customer journey:



 Ad Impression → Click → Landing Page/App → Registration → First Order → Subscription → Repeat Purchase
 


* Identify conversion bottlenecks and work with Product, UI/UX and Technology teams to improve customer journeys.
* Build structured experimentation frameworks:



 Hypothesis → Test → Measure → Learn → Scale
 


* Run A/B tests across:
* Ad creatives
* Video hooks
* Copy
* Audiences
* Offers
* Landing pages
* User journeys
* Subscription communication
* Quickly identify non\-performing campaigns and optimise marketing spends.



  





  




 Creative Performance \& AI\-Driven Marketing
   


 Mealawe follows an advanced AI\-assisted creative workflow. We are looking for someone who understands how AI can accelerate marketing execution and experimentation.
 



 You should be comfortable using AI tools for:
 


* Customer research
* Competitor analysis
* Campaign strategy
* Ad copy creation
* Creative ideation
* Image/video creative workflows
* Performance analysis
* Marketing automation



 Experience with modern AI tools such as:
 


* ChatGPT / Claude / Gemini
* AI image generation tools
* AI video generation tools
* AI creative enhancement platforms
* AI\-assisted marketing workflows



 will be highly preferred.
 



 You should be able to:
 


* Create multiple creative variations quickly
* Develop different customer communication angles
* Analyse creative performance
* Identify winning hooks and messages
* Reduce creative production turnaround time



  





  




 Creative Testing \& Collaboration
   

* Work closely with Creative, UI/UX and Design teams to develop high\-performing marketing assets.
* Understand performance drivers including:
* First 3\-second video hooks
* Customer pain points
* Visual storytelling
* Offer communication
* Call\-to\-action
* Build a continuous creative testing engine.
* Experience testing multiple ad variations every month is preferred.



  





  




 Mealawe Apartment Model Growth
   

* Build hyperlocal customer acquisition strategies for apartment communities.
* Develop campaigns targeting:
* Specific locations
* Apartment communities
* Customer segments
* Local consumer behaviour
* Work closely with sales and operations teams to improve:
* Lead quality
* Resident activation
* Conversion rates
* Customer acquisition cost
* Understand city\-level growth strategies for scaling Mealawe across markets.



  





  




 Analytics \& Marketing Intelligence
   

* Build performance dashboards and provide actionable insights.
* Analyse campaign performance beyond clicks and impressions.
* Identify:
* Best\-performing audiences
* Winning creatives
* Profitable channels
* Customer behaviour patterns
* Recommend budget allocation based on data and business impact.



  





  




 Required Experience \& Skills
   

 Mandatory Requirements
   


 ✅ 3–5 years of hands\-on Performance Marketing experience
 



 ✅ Strong experience managing:
 


* Meta Ads
* Google Ads



 ✅ Working knowledge of:
 


* YouTube Ads
* LinkedIn Ads



 ✅ Experience in B2C or D2C businesses is strongly preferred
 



 ✅ Experience acquiring customers for:
 


* Consumer apps
* Subscription businesses
* E\-commerce
* Marketplaces
* Digital\-first brands



 ✅ Strong understanding of:
 


* CAC
* ROAS
* Conversion funnels
* Retargeting
* Audience segmentation
* Customer acquisition metrics



 ✅ Experience running campaigns where users complete online purchases, subscriptions or transactions.
 



 ✅ Experience with A/B testing and creative experimentation.
 



 ✅ Experience working with:
 


* Product teams
* UI/UX teams
* Design teams
* Technology teams



  





  




 Preferred Background
   


 Candidates from:
 


* Food\-tech
* Consumer internet
* Quick commerce
* E\-commerce
* D2C brands
* Subscription businesses
* Consumer applications



 will be preferred.
 



  





  




 What Will Make You Stand Out
   


 You should be able to demonstrate:
 


* Successfully scaling paid acquisition campaigns.
* Reducing CAC while maintaining growth.
* Improving ROAS through optimisation.
* Creating and testing multiple ad creatives.
* Building structured experimentation frameworks.
* Using AI tools to improve marketing speed and efficiency.
* Driving subscriptions or recurring customer behaviour.
* Running hyperlocal acquisition campaigns.
* Working in a startup/high\-growth environment with ownership mindset.



  





  




 What We Offer

 If you enjoy building growth engines, experimenting rapidly and solving customer acquisition challenges, we would like to hear from you.

title: Product Line Manager - Greases, Maintenance and Power transmission Products
description:
****About SKF****

 SKF started its operations in India in 1923\. Today, SKF provides industry leading automotive and industrial engineered solutions through its five technology\-centric platforms: bearings and units, seals, mechatronics, lubrication solutions and services. Over the years the company has evolved from being a pioneer ball bearing manufacturing company to a knowledge\-driven engineering company helping customers achieve sustainable and competitive business excellence.
   

  





 SKF's solutions provide sustainable ways for companies across the automotive and industrial sectors to achieve breakthroughs in friction reduction, energy efficiency, and equipment longevity and reliability. With a strong commitment to research\-based innovation, SKF India offers customized value\-added solutions that integrate all its five technology platforms.
   

  





**SKF Purpose Statement**




 Together, we re\-imagine rotation for a better tomorrow.
   

  





 By creating intelligent and clean solutions for people and the planet
   

  





****JOB DESCRIPTION****




**Position Title:** 
 Product Line Manager, Industrial ISEAM (ISEAM, South\- East Asia \& Middle East)
   

  





**Reports To:** 
 Head Product Line \- ISEAM
   

  





**Role Type:** 
 Individual Contribution
   

  





**Location:** 
 Pune / Bangalore / Gurgaon
   

  





****Job Responsibilities****




**Job Summary**




 The Product Line, ISEAM organization plays a decisive role in defining the right offers by translating market trends, customer needs and business opportunities into competitive products and solutions. It is responsible for strengthening the competitiveness, profitability and relevance of SKF’s product portfolio across diverse industrial applications.
   

  





 We are looking to identify suitable candidates for the role of Product Manager – Industrial Grease, dedicated to the ISEAM business. The role will be responsible for driving the profitable growth of the Industrial Grease portfolio in ISEAM through clear product strategy, portfolio development, localization, sourcing and go\-to\-market execution, in close alignment with regional and global teams.
   

  





**Key Purpose of the Job**




 To drive profitable growth of the Industrial Grease business in ISEAM by developing and executing product, portfolio, sourcing and go\-to\-market strategies aligned with ISEAM growth priorities, regional objectives and global product line direction.
   

  





****Key Responsibilities****




 Develop and execute the Industrial Grease product line strategy for ISEAM, aligned with market opportunities, industry segment priorities, profitability objectives and overall, ISEAM growth strategy.
   

  





 Build and manage a clear product roadmap covering portfolio development, new product introductions, product enhancements, lifecycle management and end\-of\-life planning.
   

  





 Define and strengthen the Industrial Grease portfolio for ISEAM by identifying gaps, prioritizing offers, optimizing assortment and improving product line competitiveness across target segments and channels.
   

  





 Drive profitable business growth across relevant Industrial channels by working closely with sales, application engineering, supply chain and global product line teams to convert market opportunities into scalable offers.
   

  





 Lead localization and sourcing initiatives by identifying ISEAM\-specific requirements, supporting product testing and validation, developing local supply chain capability and improving cost competitiveness.
   

  





 Bring an outside\-in perspective by tracking customer needs, market trends, competitor dynamics and industry developments, and translating these insights into product strategy, value propositions and business cases.
   

  





 Collaborate with regional and global teams to align on strategic focus areas, leverage global capabilities and drive projects that support growth and competitiveness in ISEAM.
   

  





 Prepare and present business cases, portfolio reviews, performance reports and strategic recommendations to senior management.
   

  





****Job Requirements****




 Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Business Administration; MBA or advanced degree will be an advantage.
   

  





 Minimum 8\+ years of experience across sales, application engineering, strategy or product management, with sales experience being mandatory.
   

  





 At least 5\+ years of experience in an industrial grease\-selling multinational organization in ISEAM.
   

  





 Strong understanding of Industrial Grease portfolios, applications, technical product aspects and customer requirements.
   

  





 Strong understanding of the ISEAMn Industrial Grease market, including competitive dynamics, customer segments and channel landscape.
   

  





 Proven track record in sales, business development, product strategy or portfolio management.
   

  





 Strong business and financial acumen, with the ability to build business cases and make commercially sound decisions.
   

  





 Strong analytical skills, with the ability to collect, interpret and visualize complex data to support strategy and decision\-making.
   

  





 Strategic thinker with an outside\-in mindset and the ability to translate market insights into practical growth actions.
   

  





 Strong collaboration, facilitation, influencing and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in a matrix and cross\-functional environment.
   

  





 Proactive, open\-minded team player with the ability to drive change, inspire others and influence stakeholders at different levels.
   

  





 Interested, please share your updated profile – prachi.chourasia@skf.com
   

  





****About SKF****




 SKF has been around for more than a century and today we are one of the world’s largest global suppliers of bearings and supporting solutions for rotating equipment. With more than 40,000 employees in around 130 countries, we are truly global. Our products are found everywhere in society. In fact, wherever there is movement, SKF’s solutions might be at work. This means that we are an important part of the everyday lives of people and companies around the world. See more, at www.skf.com.

title: Performance Marketing & Growth Lead
description:
Meta Ads • Google Ads • Amazon Ads • Quick Commerce
 
**Location:** 
 Pune
 



**Work Mode:** 
 Full\-time \| Hybrid
 



**Experience:** 
 3–7 years
 



**Compensation:** 
 ₹50,000–₹80,000/month \+ performance incentives
 **up to ₹5 lakh**



 About the Role
 
 We are looking for a
 **performance marketer who is obsessed with numbers, experiments and growth.** 




**Someone who doesn't just know how to** 
*run Meta Ads* 
 — but understands
 **why an ad wins, why it loses, how many creatives to test, which audiences to explore, when to kill an ad, when to scale it, and how to turn paid acquisition into a predictable growth engine. Meta should be your deepest area of expertise** 
 .
 



 You should have experience scaling a brand or working with an agency where you have managed significant budgets and contributed to
 **$1M\+ in attributable revenue** 
 or equivalent scale, with a strong understanding of ROAS, CAC, contribution margin and profitability.
 



  




 What you'll own:
 
  




 1\. META ADS — THIS IS YOUR CORE JOB
 
 You will own the entire Meta performance engine.
 



 Not just campaign execution.
 



 You will be responsible for:
 


* Campaign architecture and account structure
* Prospecting vs retargeting strategy
* Audience discovery
* Broad vs interest vs lookalike strategies
* Creative testing frameworks
* Hook testing
* Copy testing
* Offer testing
* Landing\-page testing
* Budget allocation
* Campaign scaling
* Retargeting
* Frequency management
* CAC / ROAS optimisation
* Attribution analysis
* Daily performance monitoring
* Weekly growth analysis



  





 You should be able to answer questions like:
 


**How many creatives should we launch this week?** 
**Which 5 audiences should we test next and why?** 
**When do you kill an ad?** 
**When do you increase budget by 20%, 50% or 2X?** 
**Is the problem the creative, audience, offer, landing page or product?** 
**Why did CPM increase?** 
**Why is CTR falling?** 
**Why is Meta giving us cheap clicks but expensive purchases?** 
**What is our real CAC after considering contribution margin?** 

  





  




 2\. Build a creative testing machine:
 
 You will work closely with the creative team to create a systematic testing engine.
 



 You will decide:
 


* What creatives need to be made
* How many variants to test
* Which hooks to test
* Which angles to test
* Which formats to test
* Which audience each creative is intended for
* Which winning creatives should be scaled
* Which losers should be killed



 For example:
 



**10 hooks × 3 visual executions × 2 offers** 




 should not be random experimentation.
 


 You should be able to build a
 **structured testing matrix** 
 and understand which variable is actually driving performance.
 
  





**3\. Creative Intelligence** 




 You won't just consume creatives.
 



 You'll help
 **create them.** 




 You should be comfortable with:
 


* Canva
* AI image generation
* AI video tools
* ChatGPT
* AI copywriting tools
* Basic Photoshop / Figma is a plus
* Meta Creative tools
* Rapid static ad creation



 You should be capable of saying:
 



 “This concept needs to be tested today.”
 



 …and then actually making a usable first version yourself rather than waiting two days for a designer.
 



  





**4\. Google Ads** 




 You will also manage / work closely on:
 


* Google Search
* Performance Max
* Shopping
* Brand vs non\-brand
* Keyword research
* Search intent
* Negative keywords
* Conversion tracking
* Budget allocation
* ROAS / CAC optimisation
* Landing\-page optimisation



 Meta will be your
 **specialisation** 
 ; Google should be a strong secondary capability.
 



  





**5\. Amazon Ads** 




 Hands\-on experience with Amazon advertising is required.
 



 You should understand:
 


* Sponsored Products
* Sponsored Brands
* Sponsored Display
* Keyword strategy
* Search term analysis
* Product targeting
* Competitor targeting
* Amazon ROAS / TACoS
* Organic \+ paid interaction
* Product detail page optimisation



  





**6\. Quick Commerce** 




 Experience with platforms such as:
 


* Blinkit
* Zepto
* Swiggy Instamart
* Amazon Fresh / other relevant platforms



 You should understand how paid visibility, search placement, product availability, pricing, promotions and conversion interact on quick\-commerce platforms.
 



  





**7\. Competitor \& Market Intelligence** 




 This is another area I would make a
 **core responsibility** 
 , because it differentiates this role.
 



 You should constantly be researching:
 



**Competitor Ads** 



* What are competitors advertising?
* Which creatives are they repeatedly running?
* What hooks are they using?
* What offers are they pushing?
* Which products are they promoting?
* How are they positioning themselves?



**Competitor Products** 



* Pricing
* Bundles
* Offers
* Reviews
* Ratings
* Product positioning
* Claims
* Landing pages
* Amazon listings



**Audience Intelligence** 



* Who are competitors speaking to?
* What problems are they addressing?
* What objections are consumers raising?
* What language are customers using?



**Tools** 




 You should be comfortable using relevant tools such as:
 


* Meta Ads Library
* Similarweb
* SEMrush / Ahrefs
* Google Trends
* Amazon research tools
* Social listening tools
* Ad intelligence platforms
* Competitor tracking tools
* AI research tools



**You don't need to know every tool. You need to know how to find the answer.** 




  





**8\. Data \& Analytics** 




 You should live inside numbers.
 



 Track and analyse:
 



**CTR** 




**CPC** 




**CPM** 




**Hook Rate** 




**Hold Rate** 




**CVR** 




**CAC** 




**CPA** 




**AOV** 




**ROAS** 




**MER** 




**LTV** 




**Contribution Margin** 




**Frequency** 




**iROAS** 




 And importantly:
 



**Understand the relationship between them.** 




 For example:
 



 CPM ↑ → CTR ↓ → CPC ↑ → CVR ↓ → CAC ↑
 



 You should be able to identify
 **where the actual problem is** 
 instead of simply saying:
 



 “Meta performance has gone down.”
 



  





**9\. Scaling** 




 We are specifically looking for someone who has
 **actually scaled campaigns** 
 , not someone who has only managed ₹2–5 lakh/month budgets.
 



 You should have experience with:
 


* Scaling winning campaigns
* Increasing spend without destroying efficiency
* Creative fatigue
* Audience saturation
* Budget reallocation
* Geographic expansion
* New product launches
* New customer acquisition
* Retention / remarketing
* Scaling from ₹X/day → ₹X lakh/day



 We want someone who can demonstrate:
 



**“This was the starting point.** 




**This was the budget.** 




**This was the CAC/ROAS.** 




**This is what I changed.** 




**This is where we reached.”** 




  





**10\. Build the Performance Marketing Dashboard** 




 You will own weekly performance reporting.
 



 Not vanity reports.
 



 Every week you should be able to tell the founders:
 



**WHAT HAPPENED?** 




**WHY DID IT HAPPEN?** 




**WHAT DID WE LEARN?** 




**WHAT ARE WE TESTING NEXT?** 




**WHERE SHOULD WE PUT MORE MONEY?** 




**WHERE SHOULD WE STOP SPENDING?** 




  





**The Person We Are Looking For** 




**You might be the right person if:** 



* You genuinely enjoy Meta Ads.
* You spend time inside Ads Manager even when nobody asks you to.
* You understand creative performance.
* You obsess over CAC and ROAS.
* You have personally scaled campaigns.
* You know how to structure experiments.
* You understand audiences deeply.
* You are comfortable with large budgets.
* You can work with founders directly.
* You can create a quick ad yourself.
* You use AI to accelerate your workflow.
* You are constantly researching competitors.
* You are uncomfortable making decisions without data.



**You are probably NOT the right person if:** 



* Your primary skill is simply campaign setup.
* You outsource every creative decision.
* You only know boosted posts.
* You cannot explain why an ad won.
* You have never personally scaled spend.
* You report impressions and reach but don't understand unit economics.
* You need someone else to tell you what to test.



  





**Mandatory Experience** 




 I'd make these requirements quite specific:
 



**Required:** 



* 3–7 years performance marketing experience
* Strong hands\-on Meta Ads experience
* Experience with either a
 **D2C brand or performance marketing agency**
* Demonstrated experience managing substantial advertising budgets
* Experience contributing to
 **$1M\+ in attributable revenue / GMV**
* Strong understanding of CAC, ROAS, LTV and contribution margin
* Google Ads experience
* Amazon Ads experience
* Quick\-commerce advertising experience
* Canva \+ AI creative tools
* Strong analytical skills
* Competitor research / ad intelligence experience



**Preferred:** 



* Food / FMCG / nutrition / wellness / beauty / D2C experience
* Experience scaling a consumer brand
* Experience launching a new product from zero
* Experience working directly with founders
* Basic design/video editing ability
* Strong understanding of landing\-page CRO

description:
**We’re Hiring \| Content \& Digital Marketing Intern** 




  





**Location:** 
 Pune \| Full\-time

 Fresher

 Marketing
 



  





**About Kytes:** 




 Kytes is an AI\-enabled PSA and PPM software company helping project\-driven businesses improve project management, resource utilization, financial performance, and business visibility. We work with enterprises across IT/ITES, Engineering, Pharmaceuticals, EPC, GCCs, and professional services.
 



  





**Role purpose:** 




 This internship offers practical exposure to B2B content, SEO, social media, email marketing, research, campaigns, CRM, events, and AI\-assisted marketing. You will support real marketing programs while learning to simplify complex business and technology topics for the right audience.
 



  





**Key responsibilities:** 




**•** 
 Research, draft, edit, and repurpose blogs, articles, website and landing\-page copy, emails, newsletters, LinkedIn posts, social copy, video scripts, event communication, case studies, ebooks, infographics, ad copy, and product or industry content.
 



**•** 
 Research industries, companies, competitors, audiences, trends, and topics such as PSA, PPM, project management, resource management, AI, and enterprise software. Validate facts before publishing.
 



**•** 
 Support SEO through keyword and search\-intent research, content briefs, meta titles and descriptions, internal linking, content optimization, competitor research, existing\-content updates, and basic Search Console analysis.
 



**•** 
 Support social\-media planning and create concepts, captions, hooks, polls, carousel ideas, and video/reel ideas. Repurpose long\-form content into short social formats.
 



**•** 
 Support email campaigns with copy, subject\-line ideas, preview text, CTA optimization, personalization, research, and basic performance analysis.
 



  





**Additional exposure:** 




 You may contribute to webinars and events, campaign coordination, landing\-page and presentation content, competitor analysis, CRM and lead/account research, marketing reports, content calendars, and campaign documentation.
 



  





**AI capability:** 




 Hands\-on use of modern AI tools is mandatory. Use AI for research, brainstorming, outlines, questions, drafting, rewriting, simplification, proofreading, SEO research, keyword clustering, social ideation, repurposing, summaries, structured information, creative briefs, and basic marketing\-data analysis. Familiarity with tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, or similar platforms is expected.
 



  





 AI output is a starting point, not finished work. You must verify facts, understand the audience and brand context, improve the language, and apply your own judgment. Copying raw AI output is not acceptable
 



  





**Required skills:** 




**•** 
 Strong written English, grammar, attention to detail, and the ability to research unfamiliar topics and explain technical or business ideas simply.
 



**•** 
 Curiosity about digital marketing, technology, and AI; familiarity with LinkedIn and a basic understanding of SEO and digital marketing.
 



**•** 
 Good internet and desk\-research skills; basic knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets and PowerPoint or Google Slides; willingness to learn new platforms.
 



**•** 
 Ability to manage multiple small assignments, meet deadlines, accept feedback, and improve continuously.
 



  





**Preferred background and success measures:** 




 Students or recent graduates in Marketing, Mass Communication, Journalism, English, Business Administration, Digital Marketing, Communications, or technology\-related disciplines are welcome. Writing and research ability matter more than the degree. Success will be measured by research and content quality, accuracy, deadlines, productivity, SEO awareness, creativity, factchecking, effective AI use, and growing independence.
 



  





**What will you learn?** 




 Practical exposure to B2B SaaS and enterprise marketing, content marketing, SEO, email and social programs, campaign analytics, CRM, automation, and collaboration with sales, design, and marketing teams.
 



  





**What are we looking for?** 




 A curious, research\-oriented, creative, AI\-savvy learner who asks good questions, thinks independently, and wants to build a career in B2B digital marketing.

 \- Develop competitive battle cards.
   

 \- Conduct regular product training for sales teams and distributors.
   

 \- Train sales personnel on clinical applications and product positioning.
   

 \- Support major customer meetings, product demonstrations and evaluations.
   

 \- Participate in important tenders and institutional negotiations.
   

 \- Support the sales team in converting strategic accounts.
   

  

 F. Surgeon \& Key Opinion Leader Engagement
   

  

 Build strong relationships with orthopedic surgeons, hospitals and clinical experts.
   

  

 \- Identify and develop Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs).
   

 \- Conduct surgeon feedback programs.
   

 \- Organize product demonstrations and workshops.
   

 \- Coordinate product evaluations at hospitals.
   

 \- Gather structured feedback on product performance and clinical usability.
   

 \- Identify emerging surgical techniques and applications.
   

 \- Develop surgeon advisory panels where appropriate.
   

 \- Convert clinical feedback into product\-development priorities.
   

  

 G. Channel \& Market Development
   

  

 \- Develop strategies for direct, dealer and distributor channels.
   

 \- Identify and onboard suitable channel partners.
   

 \- Define territory\-wise category opportunities.
   

 \- Develop distributor sales targets and business plans.
   

 \- Monitor distributor inventory and secondary sales.
   

 \- Identify underpenetrated states and territories.
   

 \- Support international expansion of the category where required.
   

 \- Develop market\-entry plans for new countries.
   

  

 H. Marketing \& Category Communication
   

  

 Work with the Marketing team to build the Orthopedic Power Systems brand and category.
   

  

 Responsibilities include:
   

  

 \- Develop category positioning and messaging.
   

 \- Plan product launches and campaigns.
   

 \- Create clinical and technical marketing content.
   

 \- Develop brochures, catalogues, videos and digital content.
   

 \- Support exhibitions, conferences and workshops.
   

 \- Plan surgeon engagement activities.
   

 \- Develop product demonstrations and educational material.
   

 \- Measure marketing effectiveness and lead conversion.
   

  

 I. Demand Planning \& Inventory
   

  

 Work closely with Sales, Production and Supply Chain to ensure the right product availability.
   

  

 \- Prepare monthly and annual demand forecasts.
   

 \- Translate sales plans into SKU\-level forecasts.
   

 \- Monitor inventory levels and ageing.
   

 \- Identify slow\-moving and obsolete inventory.
   

 \- Coordinate production planning based on demand.
   

 \- Ensure availability of critical handpieces, attachments, batteries and consumables.
   

 \- Monitor forecast accuracy.
   

 \- Work towards improving inventory turns and working capital efficiency.
   

  

 J. Service \& Product Lifecycle Management
   

  

 Work closely with the Service team to improve customer experience and product lifecycle economics.
   

  

 \- Analyse field failures and service complaints.
   

 \- Identify recurring product issues.
   

 \- Coordinate corrective actions with Engineering and Quality.
   

 \- Monitor warranty claims.
   

 \- Develop AMC/service opportunities.
   

 \- Identify opportunities for refurbishment, upgrades and replacement sales.
   

 \- Track installed base and replacement cycles.
   

 \- Develop strategies for consumable and accessory attachment.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 3\. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
   

  

 The Category Manager will be evaluated on measurable business outcomes including:
   

  

 Commercial
   

  

 \- Category revenue growth
   

 \- Unit sales growth
   

 \- Gross margin
   

 \- Average selling price
   

 \- Price realization
   

 \- Product mix
   

 \- New customer acquisition
   

  

 Market
   

  

 \- Market share growth
   

 \- Number of active hospitals
   

 \- Number of active surgeons/users
   

 \- Geographic penetration
   

 \- Dealer/distributor productivity
   

  

 Product
   

  

 \- New product launches
   

 \- Launch success
   

 \- Product adoption
   

 \- Product lifecycle management
   

 \- Customer satisfaction
   

 \- Product quality feedback
   

  

 Channel
   

  

 \- Active distributors/dealers
   

 \- Distributor sales
   

 \- Secondary sales
   

 \- Dealer productivity
   

 \- Channel inventory
   

  

 Operational
   

  

 \- Forecast accuracy
   

 \- Inventory turns
   

 \- Slow\-moving inventory
   

 \- Product availability
   

 \- Warranty/service performance
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 4\. Cross\-Functional Responsibilities
   

  

 The Category Manager will work closely with:
   

  

 Function\| Primary Interaction
   

 Sales\| Revenue, pipeline, product conversion
   

 Marketing\| Category positioning and campaigns
   

 R\&D / Engineering\| Product development and roadmap
   

 Production\| Costing, capacity and product availability
   

 Quality \& Regulatory\| Compliance and product approvals
   

 Service\| Installed base, failures and lifecycle
   

 Supply Chain\| Forecasting and inventory
   

 Finance\| Pricing, margins and profitability
   

 Management\| Category strategy and business reviews
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 5\. Candidate Profile
   

  

 Education
   

  

 Preferred:
   

  

 \- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Life Sciences, Pharmacy or a related discipline.
   

 \- MBA in Marketing, Product Management or Business Management will be an advantage.
   

  

 Experience
   

  

 5–10 years of relevant experience, preferably in:
   

  

 \- Orthopedic medical devices
   

 \- Surgical instruments
   

 \- Orthopedic power tools
   

 \- Neurosurgical power tools
   

 \- Surgical equipment
   

 \- Medical device product management
   

 \- Medical device sales/business development
   

  

 Candidates with strong experience in orthopedic power tools, surgical drills, saws, shavers or related capital equipment will be preferred.
   

  

 Required Skills
   

  

 \- Strong understanding of orthopedic surgical procedures and applications.
   

 \- Product management experience.
   

 \- Commercial and business\-development orientation.
   

 \- Strong analytical and market\-research capabilities.
   

 \- Understanding of medical\-device distribution.
   

 \- Pricing and margin management.
   

 \- Excellent presentation and communication skills.
   

 \- Ability to interact confidently with orthopedic surgeons.
   

 \- Ability to work with engineering and technical teams.
   

 \- Strong negotiation skills.
   

 \- Willingness to travel extensively.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 6\. Desired Personal Attributes
   

  

 The ideal candidate should be:
   

  

 \- Commercially aggressive but analytically driven
   

 \- Customer and surgeon focused
   

 \- Strong in ownership and execution
   

 \- Comfortable working with ambiguity
   

 \- Data driven
   

 \- Curious about technology
   

 \- Strong at cross\-functional coordination
   

 \- Able to understand both clinical and commercial requirements
   

 \- Comfortable presenting to senior management
   

 \- Willing to spend significant time in the field
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 7\. What Success Looks Like
   

  

 Within the first 12 months, the Category Manager should be able to:
   

  

 1\. Establish a clear strategy for the Orthopedic Power Systems category.
   

 2\. Build a comprehensive competitor and market map.
   

 3\. Define the product portfolio and product roadmap.
   

 4\. Establish SKU\-level sales and demand forecasts.
   

 5\. Improve sales\-team product capability.
   

 6\. Build a structured surgeon/KOL engagement program.
   

 7\. Improve product conversion and market penetration.
   

 8\. Identify new product and portfolio opportunities.
   

 9\. Improve category gross margins and price realization.
   

 10\. Establish a measurable category review system with monthly business dashboards.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 8\. Role Philosophy
   

  

 This is not a conventional Product Manager role.
   

  

 The Category Manager is expected to operate as the business owner of Orthopedic Power Systems, with responsibility extending beyond product specifications into revenue, profitability, market development, customer adoption and portfolio growth.
   

  

 The role requires an individual who can move seamlessly between a surgeon discussion in the morning, a product\-development meeting in the afternoon and a commercial/business review with management in the evening.
