title: Senior Marketplaces Advertising Strategist..
description:
This is not a reporting seat or an execution\-only role. You will own the advertising performance of your accounts end\-to\-end — strategy, targets, partner relationship, and outcomes — and act as the eyes and ears of the ads function on the ground. That means proactively surfacing risks, opportunities, and optimisation calls before partners or leadership have to ask, and translating what the data is telling us into decisions and action.
   

  

**You will work side\-by\-side with the Marketplaces Advertising Lead, supporting them to deliver against team\-level commercial targets while running your own book of accounts with autonomy. You will be hands\-on across Amazon Ads, Amazon DSP, and Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC), and equally comfortable leading a partner conversation about commercial strategy as you are inside a bid management interface.**
 ₹0 \- ₹0 a year
   

  

**Account Ownership \& Strategy Leadership**
* Own a portfolio of strategic brand accounts end\-to\-end — you are the senior strategist accountable for advertising performance against agreed commercial targets (revenue, ROAS, TACoS, new\-to\-brand, share of voice)
* Define quarterly and monthly advertising strategies for each account, aligned to partner commercial goals — growth, profitability, launches, defence, and category share
* Lead the advertising conversation in partner meetings, monthly performance reviews, and quarterly business reviews — own the narrative on what happened, why, what we are doing next, and what to expect
* Be the eyes and ears of the ads function — proactively flag what is working, what is at risk, and what to do about it, ahead of partners or leadership asking
* Partner with the Marketplaces Advertising Lead to hit portfolio\-level targets; raise pacing, performance, and budget risks early and bring the recommended call, not just the problem


**Campaign Strategy \& Optimisation**
* Plan, execute, and monitor paid advertising campaigns on Amazon (Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display) and Amazon DSP for your strategic accounts
* Lead optimisation across the portfolio — campaign structure, keyword strategy, negatives, bid strategy, audience targeting, creative direction, and budget pacing
* Test, scale, and retire — design structured tests (bid, placement, creative, audience), interpret results with rigour, and roll winners into the playbook
* Plan and manage weekly and monthly advertising budgets across your accounts; keep spend on pace and on strategy
* Continuously improve the tracking of brand\-level ad spend and return on ad spend, and the way we report performance to partners


**Amazon Marketing Cloud, DSP \& Advanced Advertising**
* Use Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC) as a core part of how you build strategy — path\-to\-conversion, audience overlap, incrementality, new\-to\-brand analysis
* Run and interpret Amazon DSP campaigns and analytics — quantify how upper\-funnel activity contributes to lower\-funnel conversions and feed that back into the plan
* Stay ahead of the Amazon advertising roadmap — beta features, new ad types, AMC releases — and bring the relevant ones into how we operate


**Partner \& Cross\-Functional Leadership**
* Communicate with partners via email, calls, and face\-to\-face meetings — bring insight, not just updates
* Define compelling advertising strategies that meet partner commercial goals and articulate them clearly to non\-specialist audiences
* Work closely with Brand Management, Merchandising, and SEO/Content to drive an aligned commercial agenda for your accounts — advertising is one lever, not the whole story


**Team \& Function**
* Train, develop, and coach more junior strategists and the offshore execution team — quality\-check work, raise the bar on standards, and build playbooks others can reuse
* Support the Lead on partner escalations, portfolio reviews, and strategic initiatives across the team
* Adopt internal tools and feed requirements back to the tech team to make the team faster and sharper


**Must\-Have**
* 5\+ years of total experience, with 3\+ years in a hands\-on digital advertising role on Amazon — agency, accelerator, or in\-house at a meaningful scale
* Demonstrable track record of owning accounts and carrying performance targets — you have held a number and hit it, not just reported on one
* Deep working knowledge of the Amazon advertising ecosystem — Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, and DSP
* Hands\-on experience with Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC) — or strong fluency in clean\-room / advanced advertising analytics and willingness to certify within the first 90 days
* Line management or senior mentoring experience — you have raised the performance of people around you
* Strategic thinker with a strong commercial bias — you can connect a bid adjustment to a P\&L outcome and explain it to a non\-specialist
* Excellent verbal and written communication — you can lead a partner conversation and write a sharp performance narrative
* Excellent analytical skills, including budget management and attention to detail
* Proactive and self\-directed — comfortable operating with autonomy across a portfolio and raising your hand before being asked


**Nice to Have**
* Experience working with retail / ecommerce brands across multiple categories
* Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC) certification
* Working knowledge of SQL for advertising data analysis
* Experience with BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Quicksight)
* Experience working with offshore execution teams or across geographies

title: Senior Campaign Manager
description:

Campaign Managers will be responsible for implementing integrated marketing programs that engages customers and prospects, delivers new opportunities, and accelerates pipeline. The ideal candidate will have prior integrated marketing experience, strong analytical and communication skills, understanding of paid media platforms, and active campaign optimization. Campaign Managers must possess a strong inner drive to contribute.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Plan, execute, manage, and optimize managed service and self\-service campaigns
* Understanding upper funnel \[brand messaging, calls to action] and lower funnel \[direct response, conversion] campaign tactics
* Defining metrics and measuring success of campaigns using internal analytics
* Demonstrate diligence, attention to detail and adherence to best practices throughout the full digital campaign life\-cycle \[from pre\-sale to post\-sale]
* Maintain and organize campaign\-specific materials in team's shared document repository
* Closely align with sales teams and GTM priorities
* Lead daily campaign maintenance, including internal questions regarding tracking and status of various campaigns
* Develop, grow, and maintain relationships with internal teams
* Partner with Product and Product Marketing teams to ensure accurate campaign messaging
* Oversee the campaign setup and execution process to ensure accurate campaign implementation, pacing and performance
* Manage the delivery of creative assets, insertion orders, campaign artifacts, and all relevant campaign documentation in preparation for campaign launch
* Partner with Marketing Operations and Analytics team on campaign measurement reporting and insights generation
* Project management deadlines and deliverables among internal and external stakeholders
* Provide regular insights detailing performance, campaign optimizations, and new opportunities
* Work with media partners to ensure accurate platform implementation and messaging
* Troubleshoot issues on all pre\-production and live campaigns
* Provide detailed campaign wrap up reports
* Provide monthly auditing reports to partners and actualize bill/pay systems when applicable


**Qualifications:**
* Four\-year college degree
* Must have 8\+ years of experience in marketing, paid media management, demand generation, campaign management/optimization, or digital media operations
* Understanding of traditional and interactive media planning elements
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office solutions
* Strong analytical thinking and mathematical skills
* Excellent communication and writing skills

title: Senior Vice President, POM Technical Product Management - Client Entitlements & Authentication
description:
**Job Description**
 We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Senior Vice President, POM Technical Product Management\-Authentication and Entitlements, to join our growing BNY Digital Channels product team. This role is located in Pune.
   

  

**In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:**
**Product Vision \& Strategy** 
 : Develop product “North Star” considering needs of multiple business lines, competitive landscape, and working closely with design and engineering peers to ensure clear vision and long\-term strategy for execution
   

  

**Product Development and Prioritization** 
 : Lead product development across multiple pods, helping Product Owners prioritize roadmaps, backlogs, and partner intake. Define product requirements, milestones, and acceptance criteria, and drive execution by managing dependencies, risks, and delivery against agreed objectives.
   

  

**Product Adoption** 
 : Lead roll\-out for products coordinating timing with broader platform and key partner releases. Responsible for maintaining and continually improving product to ensure target adoption and results in line with OKR set in strategy
   

  

**Lead and Develop Product Owners** 
 : Help build out cross functional team coaching product management best practices
   

  

**To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:**
* Bachelor's degree in finance, Business, Computer science, or a related field. MBA or relevant advanced degree is desirable.
* Minimum 14 years of experience in product management, preferably within the financial services or fintech industry.
* Strong understanding of digital technologies, including web and mobile applications, APIs, and Identity \& Access Management (IAM), including authentication, authorization, and entitlement management
* Experience defining and managing end\-to\-end user journeys and underlying system workflows across multiple platforms and APIs.
* Deep understanding of user needs and a commitment to delivering exceptional user experiences, along with excellent communication and analytical skills.


**About Us**
 At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. title: Product Marketing Manager
description:
**What We Do** 




 FlytBase builds the world's leading drone autonomy software, powering operations for 300\+ customers in 40\+ countries—including Fortune 500 companies like Xcel Energy, Airbus, and Anglo American. Check out some of our critical deployments here.
 



  





 Headquartered in California with a fast\-moving engineering base in Pune, FlytBase is powering the shift from human\-operated to self\-driven skies. The company operates at AI speed, with autonomy and intelligence at its core. Our lean team works in a high\-agency, high\-velocity environment where AI isn't a side project, it's the operating system for how we think, build, and grow.
 



  





**The Role** 




 As Product Marketing Manager at FlytBase, you'll be the bridge between what we build and how the market understands it. You'll own positioning and messaging across verticals—translating deep technical capabilities into language that resonates with enterprise buyers in energy, utilities, security, and infrastructure. You'll arm sales with materials that actually get used, turn customer wins into compelling proof points, and ensure every product launch lands with clarity and impact.
 



  





 This role lives in the messy middle between product, sales, and the market. You'll spend as much time talking to customers and prospects as you do with internal teams. You'll need to understand the technical details well enough to distill them into buyer language—which is why a background in drones, robotics, or a related technical field will help you ramp fast and earn credibility quickly.
 



  





 The right person for this role has sharp marketing instincts, genuine curiosity about the product, and the ability to context\-switch between a product spec doc and a sales call without missing a beat.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 




 • Positioning and messaging—sharpening how FlytBase talks about itself across verticals, personas, and use cases. You'll define the narrative, not just document it.
 



 • Sales enablement—battlecards, pitch decks, one\-pagers, objection handling guides, and competitive comparisons. The stuff sales actually pulls up before a call.
 



 • Product launches—working cross\-functionally with product, engineering, and marketing to ensure new features and releases land with the right story, materials, and market awareness.
 



 • Competitive intelligence—tracking the landscape, understanding alternatives, and keeping sales and leadership informed on how we win (and where we're vulnerable).
 



 • Customer evidence—building a library of case studies, testimonials, and reference customers that make the value tangible.
 



 • Buyer and market research—understanding what enterprise buyers care about, how they evaluate solutions, and what's blocking deals.
 



 • Partner marketing—working with 50\+ integration partners to ensure co\-marketing efforts are consistent, accurate, and compelling.
 



  





**Best Suited For** 




 • 2\-4 years in product marketing, preferably in B2B SaaS, enterprise tech, or technical products.
 



 • Drone, robotics, or electronics background strongly preferred. If you've worked in or around hardware, autonomous systems, or industrial tech, you'll hit the ground running.
 



 • At minimum, a technical background that lets you read a product spec, understand an integration, and translate it for a non\-technical buyer.
 



 • Experience working closely with sales—you understand deal cycles, objections, and what reps actually need to close.
 



 • Strong messaging instincts—you can take a complex technical differentiator and turn it into a sentence a buyer remembers.
 



 • Customer\-facing comfort—you'd rather be on a call with a customer or prospect than in an internal planning meeting.
 



 • Experience with AI tools for research, writing, and presentation creation is expected. You use them to move faster, not as a crutch.
 



  





**What Makes You a Flyter** 




 • Customer obsession: You learn more from one customer call than from a week of internal meetings. You're always looking for excuses to talk to the market.
 



 • Sales partner, not sales support: You work with sales, not for them. You'll push back on bad messaging requests and propose better alternatives.
 



 • Clarity as craft: You believe good positioning is a competitive advantage. You sweat the words because you know a single sentence can change a deal.
 



 • Technical credibility: You can sit in a product review and follow along. Engineers and PMs respect your input because you've done the homework.
 



 • Launch discipline: You don't just announce features—you ensure the market understands why they matter and sales knows how to sell them.
 



 • Competitive awareness: You always know what the other players are saying and how we stack up. Not out of anxiety—out of clarity.
 



  





**What We Don't Want** 




 • Marketers who treat sales enablement as a chore rather than a lever for revenue.
 



 • People who create decks and documents that sit in a folder and never get used.
 



 • PMMs who avoid direct customer contact and rely only on secondhand insights.
 



 • Anyone who needs a technical co\-pilot to understand what we're building. You should be able to get 80% of the way there yourself.
 



 • Folks who wait for product to hand them messaging instead of proposing it themselves.
 



 • "Process people" who need perfect inputs before they can create outputs. If you can't handle ambiguity, this isn't the place.
 



  





**Why FlytBase?** 




 • H3 Philosophy: We're building a company that's Happy, Healthy, AND High\-Performing. Not as a balance—as a harmony. We move fast without burning out.
 



 • Radical Ownership: You won't need permission to experiment, build, or lead. If you see a problem, you own the solution.
 



 • Mazaa Aayega: Our internal motto. Yes, the work is intense. But it's also deeply meaningful and genuinely fun.
 



 • Systems That Scale: We don't celebrate one\-off heroics. We build compounding systems that create leverage.
 



 • In\-Person Energy: We work from our Pune office because proximity accelerates everything—ideas, feedback, trust, and impact, but travel globally for customer meetings, tradeshows, and deployments.
 



  





**The Perks** 




 • High agency team and sense of purpose
 



 • International Travel—we travel to all 6 continents (sorry, no business in Antarctica yet)
 



 • Thought leadership \& public speaking opportunities at online \& physical events
 



 • No\-cap budget for AI tools, courses, or experiments
 



 • Latest tech stack and tools—whatever helps you move faster
 



 • Family Day—Once a year, we transform our office to showcase our work to the people who matter most
 



 • Top\-tier health coverage for you
 



 • Unlimited leave policy \& flexible working hours (no punch\-in/out)

 https://www.linkedin.com/company/atica\-global
 




  





**Role Overview** 




 We are seeking a Distribution Manager to set up and scale Atica’s distribution vertical from scratch. This is a high\-ownership role where you will design processes, build relationships with demand partners, manage a small team, and directly influence Atica’s growth in the US hospitality market.
 



 The right candidate is proactive, entrepreneurial, and has high agency and urgency. They must also bring strong communication skills to engage confidently with senior US hotel stakeholders and demand partners, and ideally have email marketing expertise to strengthen Atica’s outreach and campaign execution.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Vertical Setup \& Strategy** 



* Build the Distribution vertical from the ground up, establishing SOPs, systems, and best practices.
* Identify, evaluate, and segment demand partners (OTAs, RFP platforms, distribution channels) into Tier 1 / Tier 2 / niche categories.
* Establish virtual connects with demand partners to explore opportunities, negotiate priorities, and align on hotel\-specific fit.
* Document and store all partner evaluations, insights, and performance data in a structured way for future decision\-making and scale.



  





**Distribution, Campaign Execution \& Partner Communication** 



* Own end\-to\-end execution of distribution campaigns while actively engaging with partners to drive visibility, performance, and revenue growth.
* Manage hotel listings, offers, campaigns, and updates across distribution platforms, and direct distribution channels.
* Work closely with distribution partners (e.g., Hotelbeds, WebBeds, etc.) to ensure campaigns are live, visible, and prioritized within their platforms.
* Use email marketing tools (e.g., Lemlist, LSQ) and direct partner communication to improve campaign reach, activation, and performance.
* Drive partner alignment on promotions, placements, and demand opportunities to maximize campaign impact.
* Track campaign and partner performance, identifying gaps in visibility, conversion, or contribution, and take corrective actions.
* Proactively communicate with partners to resolve issues, push for better outcomes, and ensure Atica hotels are not deprioritized.
* Demonstrate clear, structured, and assertive communication—able to follow up rigorously, push back when required, and influence partner\-side decisions.
* Maximize partner penetration and revenue contribution across all active distribution channels.



  





**Visibility \& Reporting** 



* Build dashboards and trackers for hotels and revenue teams.
* Maintain full clarity on campaign execution, rates, and content.



  





**Process \& Optimization** 



* Standardize workflows and continuously improve systems for efficiency.
* Identify scalable solutions for recurring distribution challenges.



  





**Leadership \& Team Enablement** 



* Train, mentor, and monitor associates to ensure flawless day\-to\-day execution.
* Foster a culture of ownership, urgency, and quality delivery.



  





**Cross\-Functional Alignment** 



* Collaborate with Sales and Revenue teams to align on hotel objectives.
* Liaise directly with US hotel stakeholders (DOS, RMs) for smooth execution.



**Work closely with Product \& Tech teams:** 



* Report and track bugs affecting distribution workflows.
* Raise feature requests for new processes and enhancements.
* Continuously optimize internal tools for accuracy and speed.



  





**Quality \& Compliance** 



* Audit content, pricing, and offers for accuracy and compliance.
* Maintain SLA adherence and partner agreements.



  





**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** 



* % of hotels live on campaigns within SLA.
* Accuracy of rates, data, and content.
* Revenue contribution from distribution activities.
* Strength and quality (Escalation handling and solutioning) of the demand partner ecosystem.
* Associate performance and delivery quality.



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* 2–6 years of relevant experience in hotel distribution, sales (KNR/Global Sales), or related commercial roles in hospitality.
* Excellent stakeholder communication skills—clear, structured, and assertive; able to manage partner conversations, push back when required, and influence outcomes in a commercial context.
* Deep understanding of distribution channels including OTAs, RFP platforms, GDS, and direct booking ecosystems.
* Proven process\-builder with the ability to design workflows, implement SOPs, and optimize for scale.
* Outstanding communication skills—able to confidently engage with senior US stakeholders and demand partners.
* Email marketing expertise (e.g., Lemlist, LSQ, or similar tools) to strengthen partner outreach and campaign execution.
* Strong relationship management: skilled at building and maintaining demand partner and hotel stakeholder connections.
* People leadership exposure with experience mentoring or managing associates (preferred).
* High agency and urgency, thriving in a fast\-paced, entrepreneurial startup environment.
* Willingness to work US night shifts.



  





**Why Join Us** 



* Build a vertical from scratch—not just manage one.
* Competitive salary \+ performance\-linked bonus.
* CTC aligned with experience \& market benchmarks.
* Direct exposure to demand partners, US hotel stakeholders, and senior leadership.
* Clear career growth path in Distribution \& Operations leadership.

title: Sales And Marketing Intern

**Company Description** 




  





 PLAYORA, operated by OneTap Sports India Pvt Ltd, is a sports management technology platform (SaaS) that digitizes and automates sports operations, athletics administration, and campus event workflows. The platform replaces manual, spreadsheet\-based and offline processes with streamlined, centralized tools for educational institutions and college sports departments. PLAYORA supports intramural and inter\-collegiate events while providing university leadership and governing bodies with clear visibility across affiliated colleges. It also enables college students and student\-athletes to discover sports opportunities, register for competitions, track live updates, and maintain a verified digital record of their achievements. The company is focused on modernizing sports management and enhancing the experience of all stakeholders in the campus sports ecosystem.
 



  





**Role Description** 




  





 The Sales and Marketing Intern role is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Pune. The interns will support sales outreach by identifying prospective institutional clients, assisting with lead generation, and participating in follow\-up communication under the guidance of the sales team. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include helping prepare sales presentations, marketing collateral, and basic reports, as well as contributing to online and offline campaigns to promote PLAYORA to colleges and universities. The intern will interact with potential and existing customers to understand their needs, provide initial information about the platform, and help coordinate demonstrations or training sessions. The role also involves collaborating with internal teams to gather feedback from users, track campaign performance, and suggest improvements to sales and marketing activities.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  





 •⁠ ⁠Connect and engage with colleges, sports directors, administrators, and relevant decision\-makers.

 •⁠ ⁠Understand institutional requirements and effectively communicate relevant solutions.

 •⁠ ⁠Coordinate with the internal team for smooth onboarding and relationship management.
 



 •⁠ ⁠Identify opportunities to increase engagement and build a strong institutional network across the assigned region.
 



 •⁠ ⁠Travel within the assigned region for meetings, demos, and relationship\-building activities when required.
 



  





 Who We're Looking For
 



  





 •⁠ ⁠Marketing/Business/Management students or recent graduates.
 



 •⁠ ⁠⁠Strong Marathi, Hindi and English communication skills.
 



 •⁠ ⁠⁠Confident, outgoing and comfortable meeting new people.
 



 •⁠ ⁠⁠Good presentation, persuasion and negotiation skills.
 



 •⁠ ⁠⁠Proactive, self\-motivated and target\-oriented.
 



 •⁠ ⁠⁠Comfortable with 90% field\-based work and local travel.
 



 •⁠ ⁠⁠Two\-wheeler \+ valid driving licence preferred.
 



  





 Programme details:
 



  





 •⁠ ⁠Duration: 6 months
 



 •⁠ ⁠Structure: Interns will work closely with our team on live projects related to our platform and business operations.

title: Marketing Operations Associate I
description:
**Our Mission**
 Healthcare should work for patients, but it doesn’t. In their time of need, they call down outdated insurance directories. Then wait on hold. Then wait weeks for the privilege of a visit. Then wait in a room solely designed for waiting. Then wait for a surprise bill. In any other consumer industry, the companies delivering such a poor customer experience would not survive. But in healthcare, patients lack market power. Which means they are expected to accept the unacceptable.
   

  

 Zocdoc’s mission is to give power to the patient. To do that, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace that makes it easy to find and book in\-person or virtual care in all 50 states, across 200\+ specialties and \+12k insurance plans. By giving patients the ability to see and choose, we give them power. In doing so, we can make healthcare work like every other consumer sector, where businesses compete for customers, not the other way around. In time, this will drive quality up and prices down.
   

  

 We’re 18 years old and the leader in our space, but we are still just getting started. If you like solving important, complex problems alongside deeply thoughtful, driven, and collaborative teammates, read on.
   

  

**Your Impact On Our Mission**
 The Marketing Operations team supports marketing functions across the organization. You’ll play a critical role in helping to grow our lifecycle marketing program. Your work will play an integral part in driving provider acquisition, engagement and retention via thoughtful, tailored experiences by leading execution and reporting across email marketing campaigns.

* Collaborate closely with lifecycle, creative, and analytics teams to execute campaigns on time and aligned with brand standards

* Building marketing campaigns end\-to\-end, primarily through email and in product channels
* Coding new HTML emails from design files
* Thinking critically about audience segmentation and campaign performance \& to ensure that the campaign setup matches the goals in the campaign briefs
* Building reports/performing analysis
* Participating in meetings with project stakeholders
* Executing ad hoc and short\-term project initiatives


**You’d be Successful in This Role if You Have…**
* A Bachelor’s degree from a top tier institution with a minimum of 60% in 10th/12th/ graduation
* 1\-3 years of work experience
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Strong attention to detail and comfort with Q/A processes
* Ability to manage multiple projects and timelines in a fast\-paced environment
* Data\-orientation: Understanding which data is relevant, asking the right questions, and data literacy
* Advanced proficiency in MS Excel/Google Sheets
* Independent problem\-solving capabilities
* Experience in a previous marketing operations/production role is preferred
* Experience with marketing automation platforms like Marketo, Salesforce, Braze, Mailgun preferred


**Benefits**
* An incredible team of smart and supportive people
* A competitive compensation package, including attractive medical insurance
* Amazing perks – think catered lunch every day, Ping Pong, etc.
* Daycare reimbursement
* The chance to create a better healthcare experience for millions of patients!
* Cellphone and wifi reimbursement
* Competitive parental leave
* Sabbatical leave (over 5 years)
* Annual sponsored health check\-ups
* Zocdoc is certified as a Great Place to Work 2022\-2026


**About Us**
 Zocdoc is the country’s leading digital health marketplace that helps patients easily find and book the care they need. Each month, millions of patients use our free service to find nearby, in\-network providers, compare choices based on verified patient reviews, and instantly book in\-person or video visits online. Providers participate in Zocdoc’s Marketplace to reach new patients to grow their practice, fill their last\-minute openings, and deliver a better healthcare experience. Founded in 2007 with a mission to give power to the patient, our work each day in pursuit of that mission is guided by our six core values. Zocdoc is a private company backed by some of the world’s leading investors, and we believe we’re still only scratching the surface of what we plan to accomplish.

description:
**Job Description**
**Associate Director – Strategic Forecasting \& Market Research, IME India Hub**
 As
 **Associate Director – Strategic Forecasting \& Market Research, IME India Hub** 
 , you will lead the Strategic Forecasting and Market Research capability within the IME India Hub, delivering reliable forecasts, market research insights, valuations, scenario planning, and decision\-support solutions for Human Health International markets.
   

  

 This role will act as a strategic thought partner to commercial, marketing, finance, access, analytics, and regional teams by translating business questions into structured forecasting, market research, and analytical frameworks. You will integrate complex data, forecast assumptions, primary and secondary research, syndicated sources, and market context into clear recommendations that inform commercial, portfolio, launch, pipeline, BD, and investment decisions.
   

  

 The role requires strong forecasting methodology, market research expertise, commercial analytics understanding, stakeholder influence, people leadership, GenAI fluency, and the ability to communicate risks, opportunities, and business implications with clarity.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the strategy, operating model, governance, and roadmap for the Strategic Forecasting and Market Research capability within the IME India Hub, ensuring alignment with Human Health International priorities, DHH objectives, business strategy, and regional / market needs.
* Serve as a strategic thought partner to business stakeholders by translating commercial questions, investment choices, launch decisions, portfolio priorities, market uncertainties, and performance challenges into structured forecasting, market research, and analytical frameworks.
* Lead and develop a team of Strategic Forecasting and Market Research associates, ensuring clear ownership, effective capacity utilization, delivery discipline, capability development, stakeholder engagement, and measurable business impact.
* Develop, review, and defend reliable forecasts, valuations, business cases, and scenario models that incorporate complex data, business assumptions, market dynamics, future landscape considerations, risks, opportunities, and sensitivity analysis.
* Advise and guide teams on forecast methodology, assumption development, forecast operations, scenario planning, pipeline / BD forecasting, launch forecasting, and approaches to anticipate and plan for potential future market landscapes.
* Inform key commercial, strategic, pipeline, BD, launch, portfolio, and investment decisions across the value chain by integrating forecasting outputs, market research insights, secondary data, syndicated sources, business context, and stakeholder input into actionable recommendations.
* Collaborate with marketing, finance, market access, analytics, and regional teams to address key business decisions including strategy development, forecast assumptions, execution choices, performance measurement, KPI tracking, and business case benefit monitoring.
* Develop and implement compliant market research plans, timelines, budgets, methodologies, and insight\-generation approaches in collaboration with marketing teams, agencies, and other stakeholders, aligned to business priorities and strategic decision needs.
* Engage with external market research agencies and internal partners to ensure appropriate methodologies, innovative approaches, quality standards, integration of primary and secondary insights, and compelling storytelling to guide business decisions.
* Embed automation, GenAI, advanced analytics, reusable frameworks, and responsible AI practices into forecasting and market research workflows to improve productivity, consistency, insight synthesis, scenario generation, documentation, and decision support.


**Required Experience, Skills And Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of experience in strategic forecasting, market research, business insights, commercial analytics, finance analytics, portfolio analytics, consulting, commercial strategy, or related analytical functions.
* 4\+ years of leadership experience managing forecasting, market research, analytics, insights, or cross\-functional teams in a global, regional, or matrixed environment.

title: Senior Marketing Analyst, Reporting & Insights
description:
The Senior Marketing Analyst, Reporting \& Insights is the senior measurement and reporting owner for Showpad's marketing organization. This person is trusted to take a reporting question from ambiguous, scattered data all the way to an accurate, board\-ready answer and to stand behind every number.
   

  

 Beyond building dashboards, this role identifies where the data actually lives across our platforms, leads the effort to bring the right data into Salesforce as the system of record, and builds reliable reporting from there. It is also an early adopter of AI: using tools such as Claude Cowork to automate recurring reporting and manual data preparation, while holding a high bar for accuracy. The goal is to convert repetitive, manual work into trustworthy automation so the team can spend its time solving business problems and mastering the platforms — not assembling spreadsheets.
   

  

 This is a role for a self\-directed go\-getter who is comfortable operating with ambiguity, figuring out who owns the answer to a question, and chasing it down across teams.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Board \& Executive Reporting**
* Own recurring board\-, QBR\-, and Marketing Leadership\-level reporting: pipeline, funnel performance, campaign effectiveness, channel performance, ROMI, and marketing's contribution to revenue.
* Translate complex, multi\-source data into clear, accurate, executive\-ready narratives and dashboards for the CMO, Senior Director of Marketing Operations, and board\-level discussions.
* Prepare inputs for board decks, planning cycles, and business reviews, and be accountable for the accuracy of every figure presented.
* Establish QA and validation routines so executive reporting reconciles consistently across systems and can be trusted without re\-checking.


**Cross\-Source Data Identification \& Salesforce Integration**
* Identify and map the data required for reporting across multiple platforms — Marketo, Salesforce, product usage, web analytics (GA4\), ABM/intent, enrichment, and finance systems.
* Lead the charge to get the right marketing\-level data into Salesforce as the system of record — defining fields, objects, mappings, and integration requirements in partnership with Revenue Operations.
* Own reporting from Salesforce once data lands, ensuring metric definitions and funnel\-stage logic are consistent end to end.
* Troubleshoot data discrepancies, sync errors, and gaps across the Marketo\-to\-Salesforce integration and connected systems.


**AI\-Enabled Reporting \& Automation**
* Use AI tools (Claude Cowork or similar) to automate recurring reporting requests and manual data\-preparation work.
* Design automation with accuracy built in — source\-of\-truth checks, validation, and human QA — so speed never comes at the cost of trust in the numbers.
* Continuously convert manual, repetitive reporting tasks into reliable automated workflows, reinvesting the reclaimed time into deeper analysis, platform mastery, and business problem\-solving.
* Share AI\-enabled reporting practices with the broader marketing team and help raise the team's overall automation maturity.


**Performance Measurement \& Attribution**
* Build, maintain, and optimize marketing dashboards in Salesforce and visualization tools.
* Own and refine attribution models (multi\-touch/single\-touch) that evaluate marketing's influence on revenue.
* Ensure funnel definitions and stage movements are accurate and consistent across the tech stack.


**Strategic Insights \& Optimization**
* Conduct diagnostic analyses (cohort, funnel, segmentation, content and channel performance) to explain the “why” behind the numbers.
* Analyze spend efficiency to advise leadership on where to invest, optimize, or pull back across channels.
* Support revenue modeling, forecasting, and scenario planning in partnership with Revenue Operations and Finance.


**Data Governance \& Stakeholder Navigation**
* Maintain documentation for metric definitions, naming conventions, and data taxonomy to keep the organization aligned; recommend improvements to marketing data architecture.
* Operate as a self\-directed go\-getter: proactively determine who owns the answer to a question and pursue it across Marketing, Revenue Operations, Sales, Finance, and IT until resolved.
* Act as the go\-to expert for interpreting marketing data and enables the team to read dashboards and self\-serve.


**Required Qualifications**
* 5\-7\+ years in marketing analytics, revenue operations, or business intelligence, ideally within a B2B SaaS environment.
* Demonstrated experience preparing board\- or executive\-level marketing reporting, including ownership of accuracy.
* Experience with ARR, pipeline, and funnel reporting in B2B SaaS.
* Advanced Salesforce reporting, with proven experience bringing data from multiple sources into Salesforce (field/object design, integrations) and building reporting from it.
* Hands\-on experience using AI tools (Claude Cowork or similar) to automate reporting or analysis while maintaining reporting accuracy.
* Strong technical grasp of the Lead\-to\-Revenue funnel, including conversion rates, velocity, and multi\-touch attribution logic.
* Proficiency with data visualization tools (AWS QuickSight preferred) and Google Suite.
* Hands\-on experience with marketing automation platforms (Marketo preferred) and how they integrate with CRM and web analytics (GA4 preferred).
* Exceptional data storytelling: the ability to turn complex findings into clear, “so\-what” narratives for executive audiences.
* Communicate complex data mapping and reconciliation efforts clearly to both technical and business audiences.
* Self\-directed and comfortable with ambiguity — able to figure out who to talk to and drive to answers without being handed the path.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with attribution platforms or intent data providers (e.g., Full Circle Insights, Bizible, Qualified).
* Track record of building reporting automations or AI\-assisted workflows in a marketing or RevOps setting.
* Experience partnering closely with Revenue Operations, Sales Ops, and/or Finance.


**Working Style**

title: Marketing Executive
description:
About the Role
 
 We are looking for a proactive and detail\-oriented Marketing Executive with 3–5 years of experience to support YUJ Designs’ marketing initiatives across brand communication, social media, email marketing, website, performance marketing, SEO, PR, content, and marketing operations.
 



 The role is suited for someone who can work independently, coordinate with internal teams and external partners, and take ownership of execution from planning through completion.
 



  




 Experience
 * 3–5 years of experience in marketing, digital marketing, brand marketing, B2B marketing, or a similar role.
* Experience managing multiple marketing channels, including social media, email marketing, website, content, SEO, paid media, and PR.
* Experience working with cross\-functional teams such as Design, Content, Technology, Sales, Leadership, and external agencies.
* Experience coordinating campaigns, maintaining trackers, managing timelines, and ensuring execution.
* Working knowledge of B2B marketing, lead generation, digital marketing funnels, and brand communication.
* Experience in technology, design, consulting, SaaS, digital services, or professional services will be an advantage.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to proactively identify gaps and execution issues.



  




 Skills We Seek
 * Strong understanding of brand communication, digital marketing, email marketing, and B2B marketing.
* Good understanding of LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, email marketing platforms, and other relevant channels.
* Strong written communication, proofreading, editing, and content\-quality skills.
* Working knowledge of website management, SEO, Google Analytics/GA4, Search Console, email marketing metrics, and basic digital performance metrics.
* Understanding of paid marketing platforms such as Google, Meta, and LinkedIn.
* Strong project coordination, stakeholder management, and organisational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, timelines, and dependencies.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret marketing performance data and identify actionable insights.
* Proactive approach with the ability to identify issues and opportunities independently.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with internal teams, leadership, and external agencies.
* Familiarity with AI\-enabled marketing and productivity tools is an advantage.



  




 What You Will DoBrand \& Marketing Communication
 * Develop a strong understanding of YUJ Designs’ brand positioning, tone of voice, messaging, and guidelines.
* Ensure consistency across website content, social media, presentations, newsletters, external communications, and other marketing touchpoints.
* Execute marketing communication activities in coordination with the Marketing Lead and relevant stakeholders.
* Maintain and organise key marketing assets, templates, brand collaterals, and communication repositories.



  




 Social Media Management \& Engagement
 * Support monthly social media planning, content calendars, and publishing across LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, and other relevant platforms.
* Coordinate with internal teams and external agencies for content development, creatives, approvals, and publishing.
* Monitor channels and ensure timely responses to comments, messages, mentions, and relevant conversations.
* Track performance and identify content themes, formats, and topics that drive stronger engagement.
* Identify opportunities to drive relevant website traffic, enquiries, and leads through social channels.
* Monitor competitor and industry activity for relevant content and engagement opportunities.



  




 Email Marketing
 * Support email marketing campaigns, including planning, audience segmentation, content coordination, scheduling, and execution.
* Coordinate with internal teams and external partners on email copy, creatives, approvals, and deployment.
* Maintain email lists and ensure data is accurate, updated, and appropriately segmented.
* Monitor key metrics such as open rates, click\-through rates, engagement, and conversions.
* Analyse campaign performance and identify opportunities to improve content, targeting, and engagement.
* Maintain email campaign calendars, templates, and performance trackers.



  




 Website Management \& Health Monitoring
 * Work closely with the Marketing Lead to ensure the website remains accurate, current, consistent, and conversion\-ready.
* Conduct regular website audits to identify:
* Outdated or incorrect information
* Broken links, redirects, or forms
* Missing or incorrect CTAs
* Content, formatting, alignment, or spacing issues
* Incorrect terminology, capitalisation, or punctuation
* Missing or incorrectly placed images
* Mobile responsiveness issues
* Incorrectly linked case studies, blogs, and service pages
* Issues with enquiry journeys
* Document website issues and coordinate with relevant teams to resolve them.
* Follow up to ensure identified issues are closed and conduct regular website hygiene checks.



  




 Performance Marketing
 * Understand the fundamentals of performance marketing, paid media, and lead\-generation funnels.
* Support performance marketing initiatives across Meta, Google, LinkedIn, and other relevant platforms.
* Coordinate with agencies and internal stakeholders on campaign setup, targeting, creatives, messaging, and landing pages.
* Monitor key metrics including reach, CTR, CPC, CPL, lead quality, and conversion.
* Analyse campaign performance to identify better\-performing audiences, creatives, geographies, and messaging.
* Maintain performance trackers and support campaign reporting and optimisation.



  




 SEO \& Organic Growth
 * Coordinate with SEO partners on keyword implementation and on\-page optimisation.
* Support SEO requirements for new website pages, blogs, case studies, and other content.
* Monitor SEO performance and flag significant traffic or ranking drops.
* Ensure published content includes relevant keywords, metadata, internal links, and appropriate page structure.
* Identify opportunities to improve organic traffic and content visibility.



  




 PR \& Brand Visibility
 * Identify relevant PR opportunities, publications, podcasts, industry platforms, events, and speaking opportunities.
* Coordinate with PR agencies and partners by providing briefs, company information, case studies, research, and leadership inputs.
* Track media coverage and maintain a PR visibility tracker.
* Identify opportunities for YUJ Designs and its leadership team to be featured in relevant business, technology, design, and industry publications.
* Support CEO and leadership thought\-leadership opportunities.
* Identify relevant awards and industry recognitions and coordinate nomination materials and deadlines.



  




 Content \& Proofreading
 * Proofread blogs, social media posts, website content, newsletters, emails, presentations, case studies, and marketing collateral.
* Check grammar, spelling, punctuation, formatting, factual accuracy, and brand language.
* Review content from a reader’s perspective and flag unclear, repetitive, overly generic, AI\-generated, or inconsistent content.
* Work with content and design teams to ensure final marketing assets meet quality standards before publishing.



  




 Marketing Campaign \& Project Coordination
 * Support the Marketing Lead in planning and executing integrated marketing campaigns.
* Maintain activity trackers, timelines, ownership matrices, and campaign calendars.
* Coordinate with Design, Content, Technology, SEO, PR, Sales, and external agencies.
* Follow up on action items and ensure timelines are met.
* Maintain records of campaign deliverables, approvals, and publishing schedules.
* Proactively flag delays, dependencies, risks, and gaps to ensure timely execution.



  




 Marketing Analytics \& Reporting
 * Maintain dashboards and trackers covering website traffic, social media, email marketing, lead generation, paid media, SEO, PR visibility, and content performance.
* Support the Marketing Lead with monthly marketing performance reviews.
* Track campaign and channel\-level performance against defined objectives.
* Use analytics and AI\-enabled tools to identify trends, audience behaviour, and performance patterns.
* Translate marketing data into actionable observations and recommendations.



  




 Marketing Operations \& Hygiene
 * Maintain marketing calendars, trackers, databases, and repositories.
* Ensure campaigns and communication assets are systematically archived and updated.
* Maintain databases of media contacts, awards, influencers, partners, industry platforms, and other relevant stakeholders.
* Keep marketing assets, campaign files, reports, and approvals organised and accessible.
* Ensure marketing activities, follow\-ups, deliverables, and dependencies are tracked through completion.



  




 What Success Looks Like
 * Marketing activities are executed consistently, accurately, and on time.
* Social media, email, and digital channels remain active, relevant, and aligned with the YUJ brand.
* Website content and user journeys remain accurate, functional, and conversion\-ready.
* Marketing campaigns are tracked against measurable performance metrics.
* PR and brand visibility opportunities are identified and followed through.
* Marketing content maintains high quality and brand consistency.
* Trackers, calendars, databases, and repositories remain organised and up to date.
* Issues and dependencies are identified proactively and closed without repeated follow\-ups.
* The Marketing Lead has a reliable resource who can independently manage day\-to\-day marketing execution and coordination.
